item.title: Missä voimme säästää tekoälyllä?
item.content:encoded:
30 minuutin ilmainen Tekoäly-audit paljastaa 3 parasta automaatiokohdettanne ja niiden säästöpotentiaalin euroissa – ilman sitoumuksia.

⚡ 30 min sparraus
Johtavan AI-asiantuntijan kanssa

🎯 3 konkreettista kohdetta
Suoraan liiketoimintaasi

💰 ROI-laskelma
Realistinen takaisinmaksuaika

Ei myyntipuheita, ei sitoumuksia. Objektiivinen asiantuntijanäkemys.

Kenelle

Tämä audit on tehty juuri sinulle, jos olet:

Kehitysjohtaja / CDO

Mietit, miten tekoälystä tulee liiketoiminnan kasvumoottori, ei vain kustannuserä.

COO / Talousjohtaja

Manuaalinen työ syö kannattavuutta, ja haluat selvittää automaation todellisen säästöpotentiaalin.

Innovaatio- / Myyntijohtaja

Haluat nopeuttaa prosessia ja vapauttaa asiantuntijoiden aikaa myyntiin, ei hallintoon.

Mitä Saatte

Miten se toimii?

Kenen kanssa ?

Q & A kysymyksiä

Ilmainen Audit antaa sinulle 3 konkreettista asiaa:

  1. Priorisoitu automaatiokartta

Tunnistamme 3 prosessia, joissa AI-agentti tuo välittömimmän vaikutuksen – järjestettynä investoinnin tuoton mukaan.

Esimerkki: "Tilaus-toimitusketjun manuaalinen tarkastus → 12 h/vko säästö → ROI 6 kk"

2.Riskienhallintasuunnitelma

ISO 27001 ja GDPR huomioiden. Saat listan vältettävistä sudenkuopista (vendor lock-in, data governance).

3. Teknologiariippumaton tiekartta

Ehdotamme 1–3 alustavaa teknologiaa (Azure, Google, avoin lähdekoodi), jotka sopivat *teidän* IT-arkkitehtuuriinne.

Ilmaisen auditin järjestäminen on yksinkertaista:

Valitse alta aika kalenterista

VARAA ILMAINEN AI-AUDIT

Näet heti vapaat ajat – varaa se, mikä sopii sinulle.

Vastaa 3 lyhyttä lähtötietokysymystä

  1. Millä toimialalla toimit?

  2. Mikä on suurin haaste?

  3. Mitä järjestelmiä käytätte? (1 minuutti)

Sparraus (30 min, Microsoft Teams /Google Meet / WhatsApp Business)

Keskustelemme, teetämme nopean analyysin ja esitämme ehdotukset.

Saat tiivistelmän sähköpostiin

24 h sisällä: 3 automaatiokohdetta, ROI-laskelma ja jatkosuositukset.

Tapaa [Risto Anton], AI Directorimme

"Teen useampia auditeja viikossa. Näen heti, missä AI-agentti on liikaa ja missä liian vähän. En myy – kerron totuuden."

  • 20+ vuotta liikkeenjohdon konsultointia,

  • ISO 27001 certified toimintatapa,

  • 100+ agentin käyttöönoton kokemus.

Kysymyksiä, joita päättäjät kysyvät:

Onko tämä todella ilmainen? Mitä käytännössä tapahtuu 30 minuutin jälkeen?

Kyllä, 100 % ilmainen. Jälkeenpäin saat tiivistelmän sähköpostiin. Jos haluat jatkaa, tarjoamme Bronze-Platinum-mallejamme. Jos et, käytä tietoa oman hankintasi tukena.

Voimmeko tehdä auditin, vaikka emme tiedä, mitä järjestelmiä meillä on?

Absolutely. Auditin alussa kysymme 3 kysymystä – yksi koskee nykyisiä järjestelmiänne. Jos et tiedä, autamme kartoittamaan sen 30 minuutin aikana.

Onko auditista hyötyä, jos meillä on jo RPA käytössä?

Juuri siksi se on erityisen hyödyllinen. Näytämme, missä AI-agentit tuovat lisäarvoa RPA:n rinnalle – ja missä ei kannata korvata toimivaa ratkaisua.

Ketä meidän puoleltamme tulisi olla mukana keskustelussa?

Osallistumista ei ole rajattu, ja voitte kutsua useampia osallistujia yrityksestänne.

item.title: Asiakkuusmarkkinointi
item.content:encoded:
Asiakkuusmarkkinointi Lifetime Oy:ssä

 

Yrityksellesi on tärkeätä saada parempaa tuottoa markkinoinnista.

Asiakkuusmarkkinoinnin perusajatuksena on markkinointiponnistusten kohdentaminen markkinointitutkimuksen keinoin.

Markkinoinnilla on kaksi tavoitetta. Yhtäältä hankitaan uusia asiakkaita, toisaalta nykyisten asiakkaiden tulevat tarpeet tulee ennakoida ja huomioida.

1. analysoidaan kohderyhmät markkinatutkimuksen keinoin
2. valitaan kohderyhmä, aika, kanavat
3. laaditaan räätälöity viesti asiakkaittain (jopa satoja erilaisia)
4. toteutetaan markkinointikampanja - pullit 65 %:iin.

Toinen näkökulmana on asiakaskohtaamisten hallinta, esimerkkinä pankkipalvelut:
Asiakaskohtaaminen konttorissa on muuttunut siten että pankissa käydään harvoin, ja henkilökohtaiset suhteet ovat ohentuneet sähköpostiviesteiksi pankin eteisessä. Asiakassuhde on teknistynyt, ja henkilökohtaiset kontaktit ovat vähentyneet.

Pankki haluaa olla aidosti asiakkaan elämän eri käänteissä.Pankki haluaa olla asiakkaan kumppani.

Miten kykenemme konkreettisessa palvelutilanteessa vahvistamaan asiakkaan tunnetta siitä että olemme juuri oikea pankki hänelle?

Tätä hetkeä luonnehditaan asiakassuhteessa totuuden hetkeksi (Juha Harsu, OP, tietopankki 02 / 07).
Tärkeintä on asiakkaan kuunteleminen.
asiakkaan arvostaminen(miten?)
asiakassuhde on kumppanuussuhde on tunnesuhde.

Asiakas haluaa kuulua johonkin.
Asiakas haluaa tuntea että valinta on ollut oikea.
Asiakas haluaa luotettavan tunnesiteen.
Uskollinen asiakas on parempi kuin pussillinen quickies asiakkaita.
Miksi sitten pyrkiä yhden illan asiakkaisiin?
myydäkseen tuotteita, ei kumppanuutta.

Lifetime Oy kuuntelee asiakasta. Me teemme enemmän kysymyksiä. Kannustamme dialogiin.
Etsimme vastauksia ja kysymyksiä. Teemme aloitteita. Laadimme strategioita. Toteutamme taktiikoita. Olemme saatavilla oleva resurssi kun asiakkaamme tarvitsee.

Siksi Lifetime Oy:n asiakkaana on turvallista olla.

Lifetime Oy:n innovaationhallintapalvelut sisältävät kaksi osiota:

Projektisalkkupalvelu sisältäen hankkeiden elinkaaren hallinnan.
Rahoitussalkkupalvelu sisältäen yrityksen rahoitusinstrumenttien hallinnan.

Tavoitteena on yrityksen hallittu kasvu.

item.title: Lifetime Oy Ltd.
item.content:encoded:
Lifetime Oy on kansainvälinen konsultointiyritys, joka tarjoaa liikkeenjohdon ja teknologiajohtamisen asiantuntijapalveluita. Toimintatapamme on verkostomainen ja yhdessä alihankintakumppaniemme kanssa kykenemme toteuttamaan vaativatkin projektit aikataulussa ja budjetin mukaisesti.

Lifetime Oy:n palveluvalikoima kattaa kohdistetusti liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen sisältyviä palveluita. Kohdealueina ovat tuotantotalous, ICT, kansainvälinen kaupankäynti(E-Commerce), sekä näihin osa-alueisiin liittyvät projektit.

Lifetime Oy on erityisesti kehittämässä yritysten sähköisen liiketoiminan tietojärjestelmiä ja yrityksen liiketoiminnan ydintä - liiketoimintaprosesseja.


Lifetime Oy toimii tällä hetkellä pääkaupunkiseudulla. Toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Espoossa sekä Helsingissä.
item.dc:creator: risto.paarni2024@lifetime.fi

item.title: Liiketoiminta kasvuun
item.content:encoded:
Internetin murros internet 1.0:sta 2.0:aan vaatii yrityksiä uusimaan liiketoimintamallinsa.

Gartner Corporationin (tietoviikko 3.5.07)  tutkimusjohtaja Steve Prenticen mukaan yritykset miettivät internetiä mahdollisuutena tehdä rahaa entiseen malliin, vaikka menossa on muutos joka vaatii uudistumaan.

Digital Native -sukupolvi, jolle digitaalinen maailma on itsestäänselvyys, asettaa nykyiset liiketoimintamallit kyseenalaisiksi. Toisaalta globaalit tilaus-toimitusverkot muuttavat jakeluteiden ja kilpailuedun painopistettä. 

Pieni ja lokaali yritys joka on lähellä asiakastaan,  on edelleen toimiva paketti kun huolehditaan ostotoimintojen ajantasaisuudesta ml. hintakilpailukyky. Tähän tarvitaan Web 2.0 palvelujen täysimittaista hyödyntämistä.

Lifetime Oy Ltd. osaa ja auttaa tuotantotalouden, ICT:n , ja E-Commercen keinoin yritystänne
nostamaan myyntiä 20-50% nykyisellä kohdealueella, sekä vähentämään kustannuksia 20-70% toimintoja
tehostamalla ja luomalla kumppanuusverkostoa. Autamme yritystänne parantamaan rahoitustuottoja 20-100% kansainvälisillä kontakteilla ja kumppaneilla. Käynnistämme 100% menestystarinoita sähköisen liiketoiminnan alueella.

item.title: Rahoitussuunnittelu
item.content:encoded:
Rahoitussuunnittelu on yrityksen haastavin osaamisalue. Lifetime Oy tarjoaa osaamisensa käyttöönne.

Projektisalkun kehittämispalvelut sekä rahoitussalkun kehittämispalvelut ovat erikoisosaamistamme.

Rahoitussalkussa suositut osakerahastot ovat kärsineet vuoden 2007 aikana. Viikon vinkkirahastona on Nordea Euro Yrityslaina Plus.

“Nordea Euro Yrityslaina Plus on pitkän koron rahasto, joka sijoittaa varansa yritysten liikkeeseen laskemiin joukkolainoihin. Rahaston sijoitukset keskitetään eurooppalaisten yritysten liikkeeseen laskemiin, pääasiassa euromääräisiin joukkolainoihin, ns. High Yield -lainoihin, joiden liikkeeseenlaskijan luottokelpoisuusluokitus on Ba1/BB+ tai alempi. Rahaston varat hajautetaan sekä toimialoittain että kansainvälisesti Euroopan laajuisesti. Rahasto voi sijoitustoiminnassaan käyttää myös johdannaisia saavuttaakseen lisätuottoja ja tehostaakseen riskienhallintaa. Pääsääntöisesti rahaston sijoitukset suojataan epäsuotuisilta valuuttakurssien muutoksilta valuuttajohdannaissopimuksilla.”

Rahaston 1v tuotto on 8,9 %.

Web-sivusto www.nordea.fi/rahasto

item.title: Investointipankkitoiminta (Corporate finance)
item.content:encoded:
1.Corporate finance -liiketoimintaa ovat yritysten neuvonanto yrityskaupoissa, osakeanneissa/myynneissä ja muissa vastaavissa järjestelyissä.

2. Pankkiiriliiketoimintaa ovat osakevälitys ja -analyysi-

3. Investointipankkitoimintaan kuuluu myös varainhoito- ja rahastoliiketoimintaa.

Investointipankkitoiminta ei varsinaisesti liity sijoitustoimintaan.

Pääomasijoittaminen (private equity, venture capital) ei kuulu investointipankkitoimintaan 

Puhtaan velkarahoituksen järjestely ei kuulu investointipankkitoimintaan vaan normaaliin pankkitoimintaan. Oman pääoman ehtoisia elementtejä sisältävien välirahoitusinstrumenttien järjestely kuuluu kuitenkin investointipankkitoimintaan (pääomalainat, vaihtovelkakirjalainat, optiolainat).

Normaaliin pankkitoimintaan kuuluvat myös esim. valuuttakauppa ja korkoinstrumenttikauppa  (Lähde Nordea /TKK Aineisto 2006).

item.title: Tarjouspyyntöjä!
item.content:encoded:
Uudet lait helpottavat yritysten tiedonsaantia julkisista hankinnoista

Hankintalaki, (348/2007) erityisalojen hankintalaki (349/2007) ja lakeja täydentävä hankinta-asetus (614/2007) tulevat voimaan kesäkuun alusta. Lainsäädännön keskeisin muutos on hankintoja koskevan ilmoitusvelvollisuuden laajeneminen. Hankintailmoituksia sisältävässä HILMA-järjestelmässä on 1.6.2007 lähtien ilmoitettava kaikista yli 15 000 euron arvoisista tavara- ja palveluhankinnoista ja yli 100 000 euron urakoista. Sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluissa alaraja on 50 000 euroa. HILMA on kauppa- ja teollisuusministeriön ylläpitämä sähköinen ilmoituskanava.
item.dc:creator: risto.paarni2024@lifetime.fi

item.title: Menetelmät
item.content:encoded:
Projektiliiketoiminta on johdettua ja tavoitteellista toimintaa, joka palvelee yrityksen päämäärien saavuttamista. Nykyään projekteihin kohdistuu entistäkin merkittävämpiä liiketoiminnallisia tulostavoitteita (Artto, Martinsuo, Kujala: Projektiliiketoiminta,WSOY Oppimateriaalit, 2006, ISBN 951-0-31482-x)

Oikeat Projektinhallinnan menetelmät ja niiden soveltaminen projekteittain nousee tärkeäksi yrityksen kilpailukeinoksi. Lifetime konsultoi myös projektityön kehittämishankkeissa.

Lifetime Oy Ltd.:n asiakkaan projektiliiketoimintaa  tukeva konsultointi ja projektityö noudattaa kansainvälisen IPMA:n (International Project Management Association) standardeja mm. projektijohdon osaamislinjaus Projektin johdon pätevyys 3.0 National Competence Baseline 3.0. Asiakkaalle ratkaisujen toimittaminen on toimitusprojektien merkittävä kohde.

Toimitettava ratkaisu voi olla liiketoiminnan strategista suunnittelua kuten toimintatapojen uudelleenorganisointia tai liiketoimintasuunnitelman kehittämistä. Tai kyseessä voi olla digitaaliseen tuotantoon liittyvä tuotteistushanke (sähköinen julkaisu, intranet sivusto, yhteisö, verkkokauppa, IT ratkaisu) tai sen osaprojekti.

Lifetime Oy Ltd:n toimitusjohtaja Risto Päärni on Projektiyhdistys Ry:n jäsen. “Tarkoitukseni on päivittää projektisertifikaatti vuoden aikana. Menetelmistön oppimisprosessi on käynnissä ja soveltamisastetta projekteittain pyritään nostamaan päivittäin.”

item.title: Projektoi !
item.content:encoded:
Lifetime Studios on ketterä projektiliiketoiminnan osaaja

Hankkeilla ja projekteillamme on aina asiakas, olipa kyseessä ulkoinen toimitusprojekti tai sisäinen investointiprojekti. Projektin asiakkaana on useimmiten yritys, mutta myös yksittäinen henkilö voi toimia projektin asettajana.

Tyypillisiä kohteita on tällöin erilaiset verkkopalvelujen kehittämisprojektit, esimerkiksi yhteisölliset verkkokaupat tai yksittäisten tuotteiden tai pienyritysten informaatiosivut.

Asiakkaan tarve on syy, jonka pohjalta mietitään käynnistetäänkö projekti, vai onko kyseessä pienempimuotoisempi toimeksianto, esimerkiksi markkinointisuunnitelman laatimistyö.

Ulkoisessa toimitusprojektissa asiakasta voidaan kutsua tilaajaksi. Asiakas nimeää vastuuhenkilöt projektia varten. Vastuuhenkilöiden valtuutusten tulee olla riittävän korkeat projektin menestymisen takaamiseksi.

Yhteistyökumppaniemme kanssa toteutettavat investointiprojektit toteutetaan tapauskohtaisesti. Lifetime Oy Ltd.n yhteistyökumppaneita ja projekteja on mm. Amazon.com, Google Corp., Squarespace.com. Ohjelmistotuotannon alueella on lisäksi useita betatestaukseen ja tuotekehitykseen liittyviä projekteja ja yhteistyöhankkeita, mm. Twine.com semanttisen tiedonhallinnan alueella.

“Usein tämä hiljainen tieto on arvokkainta myös asiakkaiden projektien onnistumisen kannalta. On tärkeää, että ohjelmistotuotannon ja internetin uusimmat trendit ja lähivuosien näkymät on huomioitu asiakasprojektien valmistelutyössä” toteaa Risto Päärni.

“Koko arvoketjun toimivuus tilaajalta loppuasiakkaille koko tuloksen elinkaaren ajan ratkaisee projektin tuloksellisuuden ja luo kilpailuetua asiakkaallemme”.

Tervetuloa Projektiasiakkaaksi!

 

Update on 2008-10-14 08:43 by Editor in Chief, Lifetime Studios

Panostamme asiakkaan näkökulman ymmärtämiseen, jotta voisimme tarjota asiakkaan kannalta oikean ratkaisun parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla. Kun valmistelelette investointia, on projektien ideointi ja valmistelussa tärkeää liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistaminen riittävän aikaisin kilpailuedun aikaansaamiseksi.

Mahdollisuuden tunnistaminen voi liittyä Porterin viiden voiman mallin mihin tahansa osatekijään. Myös teknologian kehittyminen luo mahdollisuuksia kilpailuedun aikaansaamikseksi ja investointiprojektin käynnistämiseksi.

Investointipäätös olisi hyvä olla edes alustavasti sovittuna kun tarjouskilpailuvaihetta aletaan suunnitella. Toki Lifetime Oy voi konsultoida myös tilanteita joissa vielä kartoitetaan liiketoimintastrategian pohjautuvaa nk. Technology Curve investointimahdollisuuksia. Myös uudet tuoteinnovaatioprojektit usein sisältävät erilaisen riskien hallinta skenaarion kuin perinteiset investointiprojektit.

Autamme myös mielellämme investointiprojektisalkun kehittämisessä Web ja ERP maailmojen yhteensaattamisessa.

item.title: Verkkokauppa kannattaa
item.content:encoded:
Perinteinen myymälätoiminta kehitetään kokonaan uudelle tasolle kun kaupan asiakaskunnalle luodaan verkkoyhteisöllinen kauppasivusto. Asiakas kokee, että hänen tarpeensa huomioidaan ajasta ja paikasta riippumatta.

Lisämyyntiä luodaan rakentamalla yhteisölliseen sivustoon verkkokauppaominaisuus. Varsinkin kanta-asiakastarjoukset ja ennakkotilausmahdollisuus luovat uutta tilauskantaa. Hyvin rakennettu verkkoviestintä yhdistettynä yhteisölliseen palveluun tuovat uskolliset asiakkaat uudelleen asioimaan yrityksessänne. Tuotearvioinnit ovat merkittävä osa yhteisön toimintaa.

Palautteellisen yhteisön rakentaminen yhteistyössä asiakkaiden ja yhteistyökumppanien kanssa on  pitkäjänteistä yhteistyötä jossa Lifetime Oy:n asiantuntemusta voidaan järkevästi hyödyntää yrityksenne tietojohtamisen asiantuntijana.

Lifetime Oy:n projektiliiketoiminta tarkoittaa, että asiakkaanamme Teillä on projektillenne osaava johto ja maan johtavat atk-resurssit käytössänne. Käytämme alan markkinajohtajia alihankintatuotannossamme sekä ohjelmistotuotannon alueella että graafisen suunnittelun markkinointitutkimuksen, sekä asiakasviestinnän alueilla.

item.title: Toimitusjohtajan Scorecard mittaristo
item.content:encoded:
Kirjassaan Strategian toteutus Robert S. Kaplan ja David P. Norton esittävät toimitusjohtajan scorecard mittariston. Strategisia tavoitteita ovat

Taloudelliset tavoitteet

item.title: Asiakaslähtöinen sosiaalisten palvelujen strategia
item.content:encoded:
”Strategia on tehtävä niin maanläheiseksi, että kaikki sen ymmärtävät – mahduttava A4:lle”

Ari Puheloinen, puolustusvoimain komentaja, Puolustusvoimat


Kiitos Vesa Auvinen ja Dazzle hienosta tekstistä:

”Suomen sekä suomalaisten yritysten ja organisaatioiden tulevaisuuden menestystekijät ”Haastattelututkimuksen yhteenveto 11.11.2009”, Dazzle Oy.

Ajatukseni:

1. Toiminnaohjauksen on oltava asiakaslähtöistä kaikilla elämän osa-alueilla.

Toiminnaohjaus tuotannossa on edellytys menestyvään liiketoimintaan, mutta priorisointi on tehtävä asiakkaita ja työntekijää kuunnellen ja näiden ehdoilla. Toiminnaohjauksen merkitystä on mielestäni liioiteltu viime vuosikymmenellä. Asiakas on tärkein voimavara.

2. Asiakaslähtöinen, yhteistyökykyinen digitaalinen aikakausi on ainoa vaihtoehto selviytyäksemme.

Sosiaaliset mediat ovat tärkein digitaalisen toiminnan muoto. Yritykselle tämä tarkoittaa ehdottomasti tärkeintä alustaa koskien kaikkea liiketoimintaa.

3. End-to-End ihmisen operatiivinen tuki ja apu prosesseissa, tuotteissa, toiminnassa.

Yhteiskunnan ja yritysten tärkein väline operatiivisten prosessien päivittäiseen johtamiseen ovat sosiaaliset mediat ja toiminnaohjausjärjestelmä yhdessä.  Cloud-palvelut mahdollistavat toiminnaohjauksen toteuttamisen myös pk-yrityksille.

Uusi Arvoketju:

Ihminen->Tarve->Facebook->Yritys->Innovaatio->Tuotannonohjaus->Tuote->Ihminen->Palaute


4. Selkeä ja toimiva strateginen positiointi ja ytimekäs viesti organisoinnissa.

Strategialla yritys ilmaisee miten vastata uuden arvoketjun haasteeseen, ja viestii strategiansa mukaisesti sosiaalisten medioiden, kuten Twitter ja Facebook,  kautta osaamisensa.

Update on 2008-03-19 15:19 by Editor in Chief, Lifetime Studios

Eight golden rules of Negotiating Skills are


1. Analyze negotiation partner before negotiations begin
What is basic thinking on issue
- what claims does other side have?
- what are their objectives?
What motives does person have.
- personal motives towards negotiation?
- use of body language
- use ofverbal language

2. Negotiation strategy and tactics
What are Your negotiation Goals ?
What are Your negotiation Strategy to achieve those Goals?
What are Your negotiation Tactics to reaching those Goals?

3.What arguments do you have?
First argument shown in the table should be most important.
Show arguments in descending importance order.
Save second most important argument last one.

4. Act and take lead in negotiation table instead of reacting on problem.
- If negotiation partner becomes aggressive offer a deal.
- Make a no / go decision.
- Reach a deal with terms that are acceptable to You.

5. Show your negotiation power to reach a deal.

6. Break through resistance -> create a deal.

7. Make agreement to last at least a year instead of one-timer.

8. Create trusting relationship with the customer.

item.title: Digital Productions Management with programmable Internet Video
item.content:encoded:
The convergence of the four screens continues ­. PC, TV, mobile phone and Personal Mobile Platform (PMP) - all become Internet video sites.

Sites already in Beta, like Joost, has shifted programming into the hands of Web companies and coders instead of television viewers. Trend is blurring the division between a website and a TV channel.

 

Broadband connections enable viewers to surf the Internet to find whatever programmes they want.

CableTV in Europe has it found new watchers.

Corporate blogs with video has become important channels for industry news and learning.

Changing Corporate attitude favouring Digital Productions should start today. Digital natives - the next generation of consumers - are not going back.

item.title: Media programmer
item.content:encoded:
Miksi työskentelisit juuri Lifetime Oy Media  Programmerina?

TietoEnator yhdistää vankan media-alan tuntemuksen ja uuden teknologian alalle tarjoamien mahdollisuuksien syvällisen ymmärtämisen. Tarjoamme media-alalle markkinoiden parhaat arvoa lisäävät tietotekniikkapalvelut. Tarjoomamme media-alalle ja sisällöntuottajille koostuu kahdesta tasosta: Laajamittaiset kumppanuudet ja toistettavat cross-media ratkaisut. Vahva asemamme media-alan asiakkaiden parissa auttaa meitä palvelemaan yrityksiä nopeasti yhdistyvissä liiketoimintaympäristöissä, joissa hyödynnämme kaikkea TietoEnatorin osaamista ja synergioita. Asiakkaitamme ovat tällä hetkellä mm. SanomaWSOY, Alma Media, MTV3 ja Talentum.

1. Java-arkkitehti/-kehittäjä, digitaalinen media (Espoo) - Haluatko luoda tulevaisuuden ratkaisuja kansainvälisten asiakkaidemme kanssa hyödyntäen uusimpia teknologioita?

Tehtävänäsi on toimia ohjelmistosuunnittelijana ja -arkkitehtinä digitaalisen median alueen projekteissamme. Olet mukana suunnittelemassa ja toteuttamassa innovatiivisia tulevaisuuden ratkaisuja asiakkaillemme mm. mobiili-tv:n, internet-tv:n ja mainonnan alueella. Osallistut ratkaisuiden määrittelyyn, arkkitehtuurisuunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.

Pidät monipuolisista tehtävistä, olet ulospäin suuntautunut ja toimit luontevasti asiakasrajapinnassa. Sinulla on sopivasti kunnianhimoa ja nautit asiakkaan ongelmien ratkaisemisesta.

Edellytämme sinulta vahvaa palvelinpuolen Java -osaamista. Suunnittelemme ja toteutamme järjestelmiä mm. Tomcat-, JBOSS- ja BEA WebLogic -ympäristöihin, joten arvostamme myös osaamista joltain em. alueista. Lisäksi eduksesi on osaaminen web- ja mobiiliratkaisuiden kehittämisestä ja Web 2.0 tekniikoista, kuten Ajax.

2. Arkkitehti (Espoo) - Toimiiko arkkitehtuurisi myös reaalimaailmassa?

Tehtävänäsi on kehittää asiakkaittemme tietojärjestelmistä Web services- ja SOA-pohjaisia, välineinä mm. UML, Java ja J2EE. Termit kertovat sinulle myös sen mitä tarvitsemme. Hanskaat UML-pohjalta lähtevän Java-pohjaisen verkkoarkkitehtuurin määrittelyn ja suunnittelun, etkä vierasta toteutustehtäviäkään.

Haasteenasi on rakentaa asiakkaittemme ydinjärjestelmät toimimaan kolmitasoarkkitehtuurin mukaisesti. Arkkitehtuurisi näkyy käyttäjille sovelluksina, jotka toimivat verkossa sujuvasti. Olipa tämä mielestäsi pala kakkua tai kova haaste, niin tule kokeilemaan siipiäsi. Niin tai näin, hyvälle tekijälle löytyy aina hyviä tehtäviä.

3. Ohjelmistosuunnittelija (Tampere tai Espoo) - Työskenteletkö mielelläsi sekä itsenäisenä konsulttina asiakkaiden kanssa että projektiryhmän jäsenenä?

Tehtävänäsi on jatkokehittää ja ylläpitää verkkopohjaista oppimisympäristöä. Edellytämme sinulta mm. Visual Basic, SQL, XML, XSL ja ASP -osaamista. Tulevien työtehtävien kannalta myös .NET-osaaminen on eduksesi. Jos sinua voisi luonnehtia luovaksi ongelmanratkaisijaksi, jolta ei puutu asiakastyön edellyttämiä sosiaaliakaan taitoja, tartu tilaisuuteen.

4. Java Enterprise -sovelluskehittäjä (Espoo) - Haluatko päästä vaikuttamaan siihen mitä ja miten asioita tehdään?

Toimit ohjelmistosuunnittelijana sovelluskehitysprojekteissa, joita teemme mediataloille. Ymmärrät hajautettuja sovelluksia ja integraatioalustoja. Sinulla on vahva kokemus J2EE-ympäristöstä, joissa on käytössä Enterprise Java Beans, JSP ja MVC frameworks(Struts), JNDI, JDBC ja XML. Edellytämme sinulta myös kokemusta formaaleista ohjelmistokehityksen metodeista ja web-käyttöliittymäkehityksestä, kuten Css, JavaScript, Html. AJAXin osaaminen on sinulle plussaa. Arvostamme myös osaamistasi Oracle-tietokannoista, WebSphere Application Serveristä, Windowsista ja Linuxista. Lue alta lisää siitä, mitä me tarjoamme sinulle.

item.title: NOKIA PRESS RELEASE (16th of October): S60 platform for smartphones software evolves to enrich the user experience. Nokia Ovi Mashup by Google
item.content:encoded:
PRESS RELEASE, Nokia Corporation, October 16, 2007.

S60 smartphone software evolves to enrich the user experience


 Symbian is expanding the S60 platform with intuitive touch user interface, 
sensor technologies and complete web video experience.
 
 Symbian Smartphone Show, London, UK - As Internet is entering into
 the core of mobile experiences, Nokia continues to implement new
 innovations for S60 on Symbian OS(TM), the market leading smartphone
 software, to develop the best possible mobile experiences for people.
 
 S60 will introduce new features that enhance the user experience and
 enable manufacturers, developers and operators to design new types of
 mobile devices, applications and services.
 
 The touch user interface in S60 smartphone software offers licensees
 the opportunity to develop devices with a variety of input methods,
 whether it is a touch screen with a traditional keypad, touch screen
 with a qwerty keyboard or touch screen alone, supporting both finger
 or stylus optimized input, in addition to the range of access options
 that already exist today.
 
 S60 touch user interface comes with support for tactile feedback,
 which means that there is a physical pulse and feedback when the user
 taps on the screen. This provides better awareness of the device's
 response improving the user experience.
 
 Existing S60 3rd Edition applications will run on touch enabled
 devices unmodified. Tools will be made available for developers to
 further optimize the touch experience of their applications.
 
 From motion and orientation to proximity and light, sensor technology
 is expanding to new areas and shaping the future for mobiles. S60
 brings sensor support to the platform as a generic solution enabling
 support for a range of sensors in S60 devices. These technologies
 open up a new kinetic world to the user and offer completely new
 opportunities for application and game developers.
 
 Also, the new UI Accelerator toolkit will allow device manufacturers
 to develop rapidly and easily impressive graphical effects and new
 types of interactions, further increasing the user appeal and
 excitement.
 
 S60 will be the first mobile software platform to deliver the
 complete Web video experience as Flash Video will be integrated with
 the Web Browser for S60. This allows people to view on the go
 Flash-enabled Web sites and Flash Video, such as YouTube, as they
 would do on their desktops.
 
 S60 and 3, the mobile media company that launched the first 3G
 network in the UK, will demonstrate at the Symbian Smartphone Show in
 London X-Series devices based on S60, and the vision both share of
 creating great Internet experiences on mobile devices.
 "We are constantly on the lookout for new innovations to enhance
 X-Series, our offering for Internet on the mobile", said Ken
 Johnstone, Director of Products, Global 3G Handset & Application
 Group, at 3. "The user experience is central to everything that we
 do, and we believe that X-Series provides the best-in-class Internet
 experience on the mobile."
 
 "S60 on Symbian OS offers a great platform to innovate with Internet
 services", said Matti Vänskä, Vice President, Mobile Software Sales
 and Marketing, Nokia. "We see experiences converging, and people
 demanding more and more of the functionalities that smartphones
 offer, both of which highlight the significance of ease of use. The
 focus of our strategy is to give people choice and simplicity - both
 key to delivering the best user experiences to add value to people's
 lives."
 
 These technologies will be available for all S60 device manufacturers
 during 2008.
 
 At the event, Samsung showcased their latest S60 devices, the new
 Samsung i450, Samsung i550 and Samsung i560. To date, 65 devices
 based on S60 and Symbian OS have been launched, 36 of which are based
 on the latest S60 3rd Edition.
 
 S60 has been the leader in converged device software since the
 introduction of the first S60 device and continues to lead by a clear
 margin, with 53% global market share in Q2 2007 (Canalys, 2007).

About 3

3 is a mobile media company delivering a convergence of
 communications, entertainment and information to customers on the
 move.
 
 The three areas which form the core of its business are:
 
 - Communications - including all forms of personal communications,
 voice and video calling; text, picture and video messaging; and
 mobile blogging
 - Entertainment - including television, music audio and video,
 computer games, and media publishing
 - Information services - including wireless web, access to the best
 of the internet and a range of news services
 3 UK is a member of the HWL group of 3G companies, which include 3G
 operations in Australia, Austria, Denmark, Hong Kong, Ireland,
 Israel, Italy, Sweden and soon Norway.
 
 Three facts about 3:
  • 3, a mobile media company, launched the UK's first 3G network
  • 3 has over 4.1 million customers in the UK and over 15.9 million worldwide (August 2007 figures)
  • The 3 network offers national coverage for calls and texts, and over 90% population coverage for 3G services.

 For further information, please visit www.three.co.uk or call the 3 Media Office on +44 845 6038333.
 
 About S60 software (allaboutsymbian.com)
 
 S60 software built on Symbian OS is the world's leading smartphone software, and is licensed by some of the industry's foremost mobile
 device manufacturers. The flexibility of the S60 software allows for various hardware designs and software configurations, as evidenced by
 the multitude of S60 devices already available on the market. Through its award-winning user interface, extensive support for new mobile
 services and the innovation potential for partner solutions, S60 provides an open and scalable business opportunity for mobile
 operators and 3rd party developers. For further information and news about S60 and the S60 community, please visit www.s60.com.
 
 About Nokia
 Nokia is the world leader in mobility, driving the transformation and
 growth of the converging Internet and communications industries.
 Nokia makes a wide range of mobile devices and provides people with
 experiences in music, navigation, video, television, imaging, games
 and business mobility through these devices. Nokia also provides
 equipment, solutions and services for communications networks.
 
 Media Enquiries:
 
 Nokia
 Technology Communications
 Tel. +358 7180 71561
 E-mail: communications.technology@nokia.com
 
 Nokia
 Communications
 Tel. +358 7180 34900
 E-mail: press.office@nokia.com
 
 www.nokia.com

item.title: Why NetSuite and why right now (On demand Web-based Business Applications)?
item.content:encoded:
Why NetSuite, and why now? Why setup Enterprise Resource Planning and Sales solution as Saas Strategy?

From Netsuite.com :  NetSuite, the first and only company to give small and midsize businesses on demand Web-based business applications to run their entire company. With thousands of customers globally, NetSuite has earned numerous awards for market leadership and innovation from such leading publications as eWeek, CRM Magazine, InfoWorld, PC Magazine, and The CPA Technology Advisor among others. Customers, analysts and press recognize that NetSuite alone provides integrated front office customer relationship management (CRM), back-office enterprise resource planning (ERP), and ecommerce in one powerful application with the modularity and flexibility to meet your specific business needs.

NetSuite is available in the following languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Russian and Japanese.

NetSuite CRM solutions and applications provide real-time business intelligence on every department within your company, automate business processes across your entire business, and eliminate the majority of IT costs and complexity—and the headaches that go with them.

 

 

Netsuite is changing the way Solution Providers such as you succeed in the mid-market, and there has never been a better time to partner with Netsuite Inc. Netsuite is becoming a public company with its success story of Netsuite.

1. Software as a Service is growing and being widely adopted by mid-market companies. OK

2. Integrated business suites are increasingly the solution of choice in mid-size companies.OK

3. NetSuite is the platform for verticalization, driving the "service-as-software" revolution and enabling you to fully capitalize on your years of industry-specific domain expertise. OK

4. NetSuite has grown rapidly, is the leading provider of on-demand business suites, and recently filed a registration statement for an initial public offering. OK

5. NetSuite is a premier SaaS partner, providing our Solution Providers industry-leading margins and recurring revenues from our subscription-based model. OK(?)

..Ok. Sounds ok to be...

Sonntag 14. Oktober 2007, 18:54 Uhr

 

Das Handy mit eingebauter Zeitung: Axel Springer beginnt am Dienstag mit dem Verkauf einer eigenen Mobilfunk-Prepaid-Karte. Gleichzeitig wird ein Mobilportal unter www.bild-mobile.de gestartet. Kunden mit einem Bild-Handy werden dann jederzeit mobil kostenlos auf die Bild-Inhalte wie Nachrichten, Sport, People oder Ratgeber zugreifen können. item.title: European Union new directive for investor services MiFID
item.content:encoded:
Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID)

MiFID – the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive – comes into effect on 1 November 2007. MiFID extends the coverage of the national legistlation and introduces new and more extensive requirements that banks and investment companies will have to adapt to, in particular for their conduct of business and internal organisation.

In bank sector Investment services will be harmonised in EU from November 1 2007 due to MiFID (Markets in Financial Instruments Directive). The directive will affect all customers buying investment services.

item.title: Lifetime Oy:ssä opiskellaan arvopaperivälittäjien sijoituspalvelututkintoa vuodelle 2008
item.content:encoded:
Lifetime Oy:ssä opiskellaan kovasti arvopaperivälittäjien sijoituspalvelututkintoa varten.
Tavoitteemme on tarjota PK-yrityksille luotettavaa rahoitusneuvontaa 2008 aikana.

Arvopaperisijoittajien yhdistys

item.title: Identity Access Management solution Distal from Emillion
item.content:encoded:
Emillion specialises in identity and access management solutions. Distal is our solution for authentication of large and medium-sized business partners. It provides an easy way to authenticate users without usernames and passwords. Bridget offers an easy way access protected content via Google Gadgets or Windows Live Gadgets. By creating trust between the service and the gadget users can acceess the content without usernames and passwords. Our solutions can be used stand-alone or as complements to IAM suites from most of the leading vendors. Distal can now be used as a SAML proxy

Emillion announces that Distal, its identity and access management solution, now can be used as a SAML proxy.

The Security Assertion Markup language (SAML) is an XML standard that makes it possible to offer single sign-on between organisations. Although a standard, the adoption on the market has been very slow, probably because the standard requires user organisations to invest in new software to be able to benefit from the standard.

Distal allows service providers to start building on SAML, without ruling out the vast majority of customers and partners not yet supporting it. The only requirements on a user organisation to use Distal federation is a basic intranet or portal and 15 minutes by the intranet webmaster. Those requirements are met by close to 100% of large and medium-sized organisation.(More information see www.emillion.fi).

Information and Access Management solutions are here. Does your web 2.0 application speak SAML?

item.title: Leadership vs. Management
item.content:encoded:
Leadership is different from management, but not for the reasons most people think. Leadership isn't mystical and mysterious. It has nothing to do with having charisma or other exotic personality traits. It is not the province of a chosen new. Nor is leadership necessarily better management or a replacement for it.

Rather, leadership and management are two distinctive and complementary systems of action. Each has its own function and characteristic activities. Both are necessary for success in today's business environment. Management is about coping with complexity. Leadership, by contrast, is about coping with change.

John P. Kotter, Harvard Business Review on Leadership.,(pp.37-60.)

item.title: The Hong Kong Situation Case HKEx Hong Kong Exhange
item.content:encoded:
A clip from Exchange the HKEx  Newsletter, October 2007

Foreign Listings on Global Exchanges

12 Companies with a foreign controlling share holding of over 30 per cent.

34 October 2007

For HKEx, foreign companies are defined as those incorporated overseas and which have a majority of their businesses outside Hong Kong and Mainland China. Under this definition, HKEx has only eight foreign companies listed at the end of September 2007. However, under the WFE definition, 72 per cent of companies (869 in number) listed in HKEx at the end of September 2007 were foreign companies — companies incorporated in places outside Hong Kong and Mainland China — which contributed in aggregate 28 per cent of total equity trading in the first nine months of 2007.

HKEx does not classify foreign companies by their place of incorporation because a substantial proportion of domestic companies listed in Hong Kong have redomiciled since the 1980s. The most popular places for redomicile have been the tax heavens — Bermuda (currently 38 per cent of all Hong Kong-listed companies) and Cayman Islands (33 per cent).

In another dimension, there are over 100 foreign companies listed in Hong Kong if foreign ownership is used as the basis for identification. These include over 50 Taiwanese companies and over 50 others  from various jurisdictions such as Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand, Australia, the US and the UK.

Although domestic companies in Hong Kong include Mainland companies under HKEx's definition, the Mainland dimension of the Hong Kong market in fact constitutes a significant “ex-Hong Kong”element. Albeit that Hong Kong is part of China, the Hong Kong financial market is separate from the Mainland market under the One-Country-Two-Systems principle. The first Mainland-incorporated enterprise (H-share company) was listed in Hong Kong in 1993. At the end of September 2007, there were 143 H-share companies listed in Hong Kong, constituting 12 per cent by number of listed companies, 27 per cent by market capitalisation and 44 per cent by equity turnover value for the first nine months of 2007. Apart from the H-share companies, there are the red chips — companies incorporated outside Mainland China but controlled by Mainland government authorities — and the Mainland private enterprises incorporated outside Mainland China. The entire Mainland dimension of HKEx — H shares, red chips and non-H-share private enterprises — constituted in aggregate 32 per cent of listed companies by number, 58 per cent by market capitalisation and 67 per cent by equity turnover value for the first three quarters of 2007.

The Hong Kong market has been successful in establishing itself as an international listing and trading platform for Mainland enterprises. Now, it has gone beyond that to be well regarded as an “international home market for Mainland businesses” — attracting the listing of other ex-Hong Kong/ Mainland enterprises with businesses in the Mainland, eg Taiwan-controlled companies operating in the Mainland. Ranked 7th globally by market capitalisation at the end of September 2007, the  Hong Kong market is an international financial centre well recognised by the world. Its attractiveness to Mainland enterprises, and potentially other overseas enterprises, lies in its substantial capital raising capacity stemming from a good combination of local and international market participants, a sound legal and regulatory framework that provides a high level of investor protection, a broad and balanced retail and institutional investor base, efficient information dissemination and communication  channels and strong intermediary service support. With its current scale and international stature, the Hong Kong market may be able to attract more foreign issuers.

Conclusion

Statistics show that most exchanges mainly list and trade their domestic companies.

London and New York are the main exceptions in attracting significant listing and trading of foreign companies. Nevertheless, the home market effect tends to dominate in the listing and trading of stocks.

HKEx has successfully established itself as the home market and capital formation centre, with substantial international participation, for Hong Kong and Mainland enterprises. With its current market scale, international investor base, sound regulatory regime and professional intermediary service support, the Hong Kong market may be able to attract a wider range of foreign issuers.

"Write now. Don't wait for an idea"

Write what comes to your fingers: write what you hear yourself silently saying to yourself. Don't worry about those things later, not now! Worry about those concerns later. - adapted from (Write to learn)

LSJ Editor

Hello world.

Today passed the application for the The Finnish Software Entrepreneurs Association membership. Since my B.Sc. in Computer Engineering I have believed to the power of software. Most of my fellows of those days started to write code in Nokia, and are still on that journey. They must be laughing twice a month for my efforts. ;-)



The IT Administration road map returned 0 to me 2003, and now that outsourcing is the door for CIO people I'm, finally ready to admit software engineering would have been better road.

BUT

Things learned so far: International Project Management, Project Portfolio Management, large organisations ICT, consulting, e-commerce, internet projects and more.

Going back where I left april 1991. What again is that thing called Semaphore (From HP-UX).

Other thing. I bought Mr. Stevenson's Advanced Unix Programming few weeks ago. He was able to update the series in his lifetime.

THEN

Ohjelmistoyrittajat RY or The Finnish Software Entrepreneurs are telling about that the growth of finnish software company does not exceed one man office, that is no more than 30-50 people.

My calculations for Consultant office is for 200+ people to become efficient.

Stress less networking ;-)



Update on 2007-11-28 11:46 by Editor in Chief, Lifetime Studios
The Finnish Software Entrepreneurs Association is a non-aligned association for innovative, professional, growth-friven and entrepreneurial software business executives. Association drives the success of software business as an industry and supports individual software companies in their road to success.

Currently, there are approximately 200 members. Association operates Finland-wide, covering all the major cities having software companies and entrepreneurship.

We offer broad offering for software company executives including training, networking, business development forums, growth cliniquesa and ability to impact the governmental and industry-level decission making.

Our intent is to raise the awareness of software business as one of the key growing industries in Finland. We are also pushing positive messages out to the media to improve image of industry and the copanies within.

item.title: Grand Opening: Flagship Stadium 15th of October in Helsinki
item.content:encoded:
My first visit to Stadium shops happened in 1989 in http://www.Stockholm.se/. My friend and I had normal weekend off boat travel with http://www.vikingline.fi/ to Swedish capital. The first Stadium Store Stockholm were opened in 1987.

A brief Stadium Retail Chain History

The foundation on which Stadium is built was laid back in 1974, when Ulf Eklöf took over the Spiralen Sport store in Norrköping. At the time it was an ordinary sports store, covering an area of 180 m2. Spiralen Sport quickly developed into a sports department store, focusing on low prices and large volumes. Norrköping is also home to the parent company Stadium AB and the Service Office.

The first Stadium store opened in 1987 on Sergelgatan in Stockholm. Stadium was created as an arena of experiences. The characteristic running tracks, the product display solution and the store entrance formed the basis of a new concept that revolutionised the entire sports industry.

The retail store chain opened it's new shop in stadium.Stockholm.se.

15th of October a new shop will be opened in Helsinki at 9.00 am. Be there to get all the discounts. Apply also Stadium Card, a discount card for active family.

Great discounts and More  about Stadium.fi

Other business activities
In addition to the Stadium stores, the Group also comprises Red Devil, Edins, Sports Outlet, Sportlagret and Stadium Promotion AB, a company making profile and campaign products for companies and organisations.

It was Stadium Promotion that designed the clothes for the Swedish Olympic Team, both in Nagano, Sydney, Salt Lake City, Athens and Torino.

Stadium supports an active life for young people.

item.title: Opensocial API with Google - how will Facebook respond?
item.content:encoded:
New Google Corporation API is Opensocial.

Note: This is an API standard used by many API providers, not just Google. For all compatible APIs listed on ProgrammableWeb, use the opensocial tag. OpenSocial provides a common set of APIs for social applications across multiple websites. With standard JavaScript and HTML, developers can create apps that access a social networks friends and update feeds. There are two ways to access the OpenSocial API: client-side using the JavaScript API and server-side using RESTful data APIs.  http://www.programmableweb.com/api/opensocial

item.title: Selling hamburgers and consulting
item.content:encoded:
When McDonald's opens a new restaurant the criteria is

1.The Reach - Place is essential for the people to enter  McDonald's. More people means more customers.

2.The Price -  Offering Prices are affordable compared the country price levels.

3. Marketing - Promotion campaigns are well designed and tailored to attract local people.

4. Product - Some of the products are always local specialities, like rhye bread hamburger (RuisMac) here in Finland. Finns also like to eat salads in a prepackaged form, salads bars are not available for some reason.

I bet McRye or RuisMac is not available in Texas (or is it really)? 

What is difference then compared to selling consulting hours? See Lifetime Oy Ltd.'s updated pages in English and in Finnish.

item.title: Kindle offering include books, newspapers, blogs. Make your income from business blogging
item.content:encoded:
The Amazon Kindle is unique device. With size of smaller than laptop but larger than most mobile devices it offers good reading platform.

With wireless communication books are easy to download to the device. It also delivers hundreds of newspapers daily. This is important for anyone who tries to stay in touch local news.

For me the best thing about Amazon.com Kindle is that offers a channel for serious bloggers to make some income. Presenting a calculus of business blogs based on to subscription model feels much better reasoning in the business plan than just announcing income is found with affiliate marketing.

Really well done, Amazon !

I hope that someone in the Nokia / Symbian platform could do the same. Thank You Nokia!

item.title: My best Christmas present so far
item.content:encoded:
The Software Industry is somewhat strange animal.

Most company players seem to play little dirty with their marketing. Friendly and cruel. I have not found any exception in this among the big players.

My most memorable Christmas present was 2003 from company called SAP. After my career as CIO ended 2002 those days SAP sent me Grill Barbecue Set for my efforts in SAP Developer Network. My thoughts were those days in SOA, or Service Oriented Architecture, and SAP was transforming it offering to more 'open' with Microsoft and J2EE interfaces to their core software. They promised a pen too but I did not receive that. I wonder when it will arrive?

So Ossi, please send me your address and I'll send that Barbecue set back to You as Christmas present 2007. I has been long enough with me ;-). The Grill set is yours.

OK. Today with social media, web 2.0, it is even more clear that in the industrial Management scenario  ERP solutions in general has brought efficiency that we - those days IT staff -  from the PC network of Novell/Microsoft 2k world could not deliver.

But since factories are factories, and people will stay people, I truly think that the era of ERP admiration ends today for my lifetime.Goodbye ERP. You are the best for the factory.

My promise for 2008 is, that Lifetime Oy Ltd. tries to be good and fair for the people. Wether its friends, partners, bloggers, competitors.

Third channel for blog readers is social media links and articles.

Fourth channel is mobile. You can already read this blog from Kaywa.com reader.

Widsets.com channel for mobile is also on its way thanks to the new easy widget creator feature.

iPhone specific channel is under examination. What should I do here?

2005 I tried to podcast some casts but with my finglish this hears to be out of the question unless I can hire someone fluent enough with spoken English.

Also some Youtube material could be useful later on, especially from customer work shops etc.

But before this - next week or so it is time for family and for stress less life.

For LSJ new entries in January will deal more focused to the things mentioned in the media card.

item.title: Lifetime Oy Ltd. Company Profile
item.content:encoded:
Please give some advice, dear reader - how can we improve? 

Company Profile

Lifetime Oy Ltd. is a small-sized consultant company specialized in digital productions and Project Management, located in Helsinki, the Capital of Finland, Europe. The number of personnel is currently two full-time and a network of freelance consultants and partners.

Lifetime Oy Ltd. was established in 1989 as a result of five students creating in a start-up. The Original business idea was import of laptops, media products and Telecom products.

In 1992 other students slipped away to other duties while current owner of the company stayed in while shifting business idea into software production. At the time multimedia applications were sold f.e. University of Helsinki.

Lifetime Oy Ltd. export 95 % of it's productions, it's main export markets being in EU, especially in the Scandinavia, UK, and Germany. In spite of tough competition, the company has done very well with the newest technologies.

The plan is to grow to 200 consultant multi productions company in coming years.
Own innovative products are also under careful planning.

As to the company's performance this year, currently in pre-seed phase of few business ideas, expected net sales will be ca. 60 thousand euros for 2007-2008.

The foundation of the company's vigorous growth is in its specialization, state of the art technology, expertise, focus in customer related projects, and own innovative products and services. 

The future looks bright and the company  intends to keep on expanding in the global electronic trade, consulting,  and web 2.0 projecting market.

item.title: First North Rulebook
item.content:encoded:
First North is an alternative marketplace for small growth companies, providing a world of opportunities on the Nordic and global financial markets. It gives companies greater visibility and ease of access to Northern Europe's largest pool of capital, combining the benefits of being on-market with simplicity. First North is a part of OMX Nordic Exchange. That means that the companies admitted to trading at First North are given the same possibilities as large companies, but the regulations are lighter.

 
And when the company is ready for the main list First Northn Entry opens possibilities.

Tiesitkö että Lifetime Oy:stä saatte yrityksenne hallitukseen osaamista mm. teknologiayrittäjyyden, tuotantotalouden, tietotekniikan alueilta. Käytössämme on useita päteviä hallitustyöskentelyn ammattilaisia jotka voivat auttaa yritystänne. Yrityksen hallitus on merkittävin yrityksen strategian rakentaja. Vahvan hallituksen rakentaminen edistää yrityksen myönteistä kuvaa mm. sijoittajien näkökulmasta.


When Company is entering the Scandinavian First North Market Place the requirements are made for the shares. 

2.2.1 Requirements for shares (adapted from the First North Rule Book 2007 )


In order for shares to be admitted to trading on First North, conditions for sufficient supply and demand must exist. The Exchange will consider this requirement to be satisfied in the following non-exhaustive list of circumstances:
• if there is a sufficient number of shareholders, and
• if at least 10 percent of the share class to be admitted are held by the general public. ”General public” means persons who directly or indirectly own less than 10 per cent of the share capital or voting capital, or
• if the Company retains the services of a liquidity provider.

4.3 Website
The Company must have its own website on which all published information from the Company to the market shall, unless special cause exists, be readily available for at least two years.


Annual reports, prospectuses, and other information provided for distribution to, or kept available to, shareholders shall be readily available on the website, unless special cause exists.


The website shall also include the Company’s articles of association as in force from time to time and details of the current Board of Directors and senior management and also the name of the Certified Adviser.

4.5 Annual report and accounting principles
The annual report shall be prepared in accordance with applicable laws or other regulations and in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the Company’s home state. If the accounting principles in the Company’s home country cannot be regarded as generally accepted, the Exchange may demand supplementary accounting information.


4.6 Report of annual earnings figures and half-yearly reports


After the Company's Board of Directors has approved the annual accounts, the Company shall immediately publish a report of annual earnings figures containing the most important information from the forthcoming annual report.


The Company must publish a half-yearly report.


Reports of annual earnings figures and half-yearly reports shall be published as soon as possible, however not later than within three months from the expiry of the reporting period for reports of annual earnings figures and within two months for half-yearly reports. Such reports shall include a statement whether or not the Company’s auditor has conducted a review.
 
If a Company decides to publish quarterly reports, then the requirements set out in paragraph three for half-yearly reports shall apply. Quarterly reports shall in such circumstances also include the information set out in sub-paragraphs a) to i) below. For the avoidance of doubt, companies may publish financial information to the market on a quarterly basis in another format than as quarterly reports. In such circumstances, the requirements in the Rules for quarterly reports will not apply.
 

Reports of annual earnings figures and half-yearly reports (except for sub-paragraphs j-l) shall always include:


a) a summarized income statement for the financial year and the most recent half-yearly period, including comparative figures for the same period during the previous financial year;


b) the balance sheet in summary as of the close of the current reporting period, including comparative figures from the close of the most recent financial year;


c) a cash flow statement in summary for the financial year and half-yearly period, including comparative figures for the same period during the previous financial year;


d) a summary report showing changes in equity during the financial year and half-yearly period, including comparative figures for the same period during the previous financial year;


e) the net earnings per share for the financial year and the half-yearly period including comparative figures for the same period during the previous financial year. Information shall be provided before and after the dilution effects of outstanding convertible debentures, corporate warrants, and suchlike where such dilution significantly reduces earnings per share;


f) information regarding the number of outstanding shares at the close of the reporting period and the average number of outstanding shares for the financial year and half-yearly period, including comparative figures for the same period during the previous financial year. The information shall be provided both before and after the exercise of outstanding convertible debentures, corporate warrants, and suchlike where such does not give rise to a substantial increase in the number of common shares;


g) explanations of the earnings trend and financial position during the most recent half-yearly period including, inter alia, the effect of significant extraordinary events;


h) where information relating to the future is provided, the corresponding information provided in the previous report as well as any changes published since the previous report should also be stated;


i) information regarding the date of publication of the next report of unaudited annual earnings figures or half-yearly report;


j) proposed allocation of profits;


k) information in respect of the planned date of the annual general meeting of the shareholders;


l) information as to where and when the annual report and financial statements will be made available to the public.

4.7 Forecasts and forecast adjustments


Where a company that has published a forecast regarding financial results or turnover finds that the conditions have changed in such a way that the result is believed to significantly deviate from the forecast, the Company shall immediately publish such information.


If a company intends to release a forecast adjustment or other unexpected significant changes in the financial results and it is assumed that the information will have a significant effect on the share price, the Exchange and the Certified Adviser must be contacted as soon as practically possible before the information is published.


4.8 General meetings
Notices to attend general meetings shall be published in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter in conjunction with the issuance of such notice.
The Company shall, in a press release/announcement from the general meeting, immediately publish information that is of significance for the market.

4.9 Changes in the Company’s management, advisers etc.


All changes in the composition of the Board of Directors, any significant management changes and the resignation or dismissal of auditors, replacement of the Company’s Certified Adviser and information on any concluded or cancelled agreement with a liquidity provider shall be published.

4.10 Incentive programs
A decision by the Company to introduce a share-based incentive program must be disclosed. The information about this must sufficiently detailed to facilitate an assessment of the program’s impact on the Company’s earnings and financial position.


4.11 Offering of new shares

Where the Board of Directors or the general meeting of shareholders of the Company has adopted a resolution in respect of the issuance of new shares or financial instruments with a right to subscribe for newly issued shares or where the Board of Directors decides to propose such a resolution to the general meeting of shareholders, the Company shall immediately publish the resolution, the reasons for the issue, the principal terms and conditions for the issue, as well as the party/parties to whom the issue is directed.


4.12 Information to the Exchange or the Certified Adviser

The Company shall inform the Certified Adviser about the Company and its business and also provide all information to enable the Certified Adviser to fulfil the Company’s responsibilities as set forth in the Rules.

The Company shall notify the Certified Adviser as soon as possible in respect of new issues, name changes, splits and other similar corporate actions.12 The Certified Adviser is responsible for notifying the Exchange, which undertakes to disseminate the information to the market.

Where criticism is communicated by the auditors to the Board of Directors or the Company’s President in accordance with applicable law in the Company’s home state, the Company shall immediately convey such criticism to the Certified Adviser.

The Company shall notify the Exchange and the Certified Adviser immediately of circumstances that might necessitate a trading halt.


4.13 Disclosure of insider transactions
The Company shall require persons discharging managerial responsibilities and persons closely associated with a person discharging managerial responsibilities within an issuer of financial instruments to notify the Company of transactions in the Company’s shares and share related financial instruments. The Company shall publish information about such transactions on its website.

item.title: Guide to managerial communication
item.content:encoded:
Managerial communication is different from other kinds of communication. Why? Because in a business or management setting, a brilliant message alone is not sufficient.

You are successful only if your message leads to the response you desire from your audience.

According Mary Munter, author of the leading text business communication, strategic communication is based on five interactive variables:

1. communicator   [desides]

2. audience strategy [which affects]

3. the message strategy [is based on your objectives]

4. channel choice strategy, and

5. cultural context strategy.

 

Write to Learn 

Focus on your audience (Idea for the writing composition process is from Murray, D., Learn to write, sixth edition and paperback editions).

Focus on your audience's needs and concerns:put yourself in their shoes.

By appreciating the uniqueness of each customer, by recognizing and understanding your customer,

you can help differentiate yourself, your products, and your organisation.

Explore 

Gather files, articles, financial statements, links, interviews, etc. to daybook or journal.

Plan 

Plan the text and presentation. Create the road map. 

Draft

Organise and focus first. Compose in any order. Avoid editing. Get a typed hard copy.

Leave a time gap before editing.

Clarify 

Edit for strategy. Edit for macro issues. Edit for micro issues and for correctness.
item.dc:creator: risto.paarni2024@lifetime.fi

wp:comment.wp:comment_content:
Macrowriting issues include:
1) Document design for "high skim value" so busy readers can skim your document. Add readability.

2) Structural signposts for connection so readers can easily see the connection, logical progression, and flow between ideas e.g. 'I know what you mean'.Show logical progression.

3) Effective paragraphs or sections so readers can understand the text easily. Organise paragraphs and sections.

Micro Issues in writing include goals to make writing concise and to make tone appropriate.

Micro Issues in writing include knowledge of correct grammar and punctuation.

Remember to avoid wordiness and overlong sentences.

Watch your prepositions.

Dear writer, you should create businesslike, active voice, no jargon content.

Business style uses short words and phrases.

Use active voice when you want to avoid wordiness, avoid formality, place responsibility, and save your reader time.


Please follow these advices when writing Lifetime Journal !
Improve quality control !

"If advertising and public relations were the best ways to connect with a company's audience through traditional media, and blogs are the best way to connect with millions of customers through the medium of online consumer generated media, then how can companies best use blogs to connect with their audience through the medium of consumer-generated media?
The answer is through blogger relations, the process of interacting with bloggers and blog readers to get a company's message to an audience.
This book targets business people, marketing professionals, public relations firms, search engine optimization and online marketing agency staff with a primer on the importance of corporate blogging and how to conduct a successful blogger relations ongoing campaign.
* Provides tools for companies to interact with customers through blogging communities
* Shows how to transform public relations and search marketing through consumer-generated media, RSS feeds and comment interaction strategies
* Describes how to optimize blog articles for blog search engines and provides content strategies
* Provides companies the planning tools to evaluate its blogging community and company resources for effective blogging"
Lifetime Scope - Journal is typical example of corporate blogging. We are building blog confident that it will successfully deliver content to business people like managers.
As independent corporate blog Lifetime Scope - Journal delivers true value to its expanding fans and blog user network. (already over 10.000 hits/mo)

item.title: Managerial presentation skills
item.content:encoded:
Business communication is the most important skill for an entrepreneur. When considering Business Angel meeting, or Customer Sales meeting your presentation skills make the difference to win them to your side.


Designing the presentation as a whole

        A1. Create listing of main ideas on an agenda chart

"preview" chart outlines your presentation. It serves as a presentation's "table of contents". Items in the preview should be structural signposts for the following pages.

        A2. Provide evidence on back-up charts

 Rest of the charts in your presentation are made up of support, or "back-up" visuals.

        A3. Use message titles and stand-alone sense

Use the head line to reinforce the main concept in that visual. Create visual so that someone seeing the chart first time will understand it "stand-alone".

        A4. Provide effective transitions between each visual slide

When designing the visuals for a tell/sell presentation as a whole, think about how you going to provide transitions between each visual.

Transition technique #1: Create consistency in headings and subheadings.

Transition technique #2: Use Repeated use of agenda slide "box" & "highlight / dim".

Transition technique #3: Use of trackers to show attendees presentation structure and where we are going. A tracker is a shortened version of the main point on your agenda chart.

        A5. Use presentation software and necessary equipment for the showcase.

An effective presentation includes use of presentation software.

Also consider using flip charts, LCD  /CRT projectors and overheads to show visuals and further information.

 

The structure of a good sales presentation include 

1. An opening

Open the presentation with a persuasive "grabber". Make positive first impression with the main message for the first minute. Deliver the main message in the opening. Group main messages in descending order. Leave the second most important message to the last. see my entry Audience memory curve from wikipedia.org.

2. A preview of the main points

briefly show "table of contents" for the presentation. 

3. Clearly demarcated main points

In the following charts show main points in descending order. Less charts is many times better. Avoid wordiness.

4. a closing

When reaching end of the presentation mark second most important thing in the ending. Get Feedback with Q & A session. Call to Action. Goodwill ending. Avoid pitfalls. 

 Designing each individual chart

B1. Design and implement graphs to show quantitative data, such as financial information, marketing projections, or operations analyses. Chart types include Pie, Bar, Line, Column, Correlation, etc.

B2. Design and implement diagrams to show nonquantative concepts

Steps in a process , Flows(time, Command, Organisation, Process), Cause and effect, change, interrelation, Barriers/penetration. Chart types include process charts, drawings, arrow-head chart etc. [adapted from G.Zelazny, Say it With Charts]

B3. Use word charts to show main ideas of the business presentation. Word charts are not word-for-word scripts that echo what you are saying throughout the presentation. Instead, reserve word chart for key messages you really want to emphasize and listeners to remember. Avoid overload. Rule of thumb "six by six rule" - six lines of text, six words in a line. Sometimes you may find it necessary to break this rule, but don't do it in every slide.

B4. Use typography effectively

Typography - including font, size, use of boldface, italics, capitals, and so forth-is an important feature of both graphic and word charts. Use standard capitalization. Avoid letter junk.

B5. Editing each chart

Avoid overload. Delete chart junk. 


 

If you want to learn more see  resources from Lifetime Friend Gift Shop.

item.title: Consentrating to products 1: Real Estate companies, Great Portland Estates
item.content:encoded:
Great Portland Estates is a central London property investment and development company owning over £1.5 billion of real estate. "We aim is to deliver superior returns to shareholders through active asset management, the application of our development skills to create value and  maximising of equity returns through efficient structuring and flexible financing" (Annual Report 2007). Great Portland Estates business mix include Office - £1,195.6m (22%) and Retail - £340.0m (78 %). The company operates in three main locations West End - £1,259.0m (82%), City - £169.1m (11 %), and Southwark - £107.5m (7 %).

Financial highlights (year to 31 March 2007)

Portfolio value including share of JVs

£ 1,535.6m +24.8%

Profit before taxation

£326.0m +73.4% 

Adjusted net assets per share

594p +35.9% 

Adjusted earnings per share

10.2p +0% 

The Company has a clear and straightforward strategy." We have made excellent progress against our specific objectives".

1) Develop,

Strategic priorities include: deliver near-term programme on time and budget. Bring forward existing medium-term projects. Add to medium and long-term pipeline.

2) Recycle Capital,

Strategic priorities include: buy properties with low relative rents, with angles to exploit, and to grow medium-term development programme. Sell properties with historically high capital values. With limited further angles. Where capturing rental growth will be difficult.

3) Asset Manage

Strategic priorities include: execute individual property strategies. Create value through asset repositioning.

Great Portland Estates performance was excellent. The success of the group in meeting its strategic objectives is judged by its performance against independent benchmarks using four key performance indicators; Total Shareholder Return (TSR); NAV per share growth; Portfolio Total Property Return (TPR) and Return on Capital Employed (ROCE).

Chairman Mr. Richard Peskin statement:" It has been an active year in every aspect of our business. With the investment market remaining strong, sensible rationalisation has continued at excellent prices, and at the same time we found some attractive purchases."

The name "Google" is a play on the word "googol," which was invented by Milton Sirotta, nephew of American mathematician Edward Kasner. A googol refers to the number represented by a 1 followed by 100 zeros (A googol is a very large number).

There isn't a googol amount of anything in the universe -- not stars, not dust particles, not atoms. Google's use of the term reflects company's mission to organize the world's immense (and seemingly infinite) amount of information and make it universally accessible and useful.

item.title: Market orientation (Kohli and Jaworski 1990):The real customer focus and responsiveness of the company
item.content:encoded:
The term market orientation generally refers to the implementation of the marketing concept.

 A Market orientation entails (1) one or more departments engaging in activities  geared toward developing an understanding of customers' current and future needs and the factors affecting them, (2) sharing of this understanding across departments, and (3) the various departments engaging in activities designed to meet select customer needs.

In other words, a market orientation refers to the organization-wide generation, dissemination, and responsiveness to market intelligence.

item.content:encoded:
Hello lifetime friends,

Now that lifetime scope journal  (LSJ) is having its 1-year party I stopped for a minute to think what are directions this magazine and corporate blogging platform should be concentrating on.

 I would very much to get some decent feedback from you readers. What are we doing well? What we should aim at? Critical reviews are converted lessons learned as much possible.

 

Currently my view is that Lifetime Scope Journal aims to products, brands, innovation management, venture management, web 2.0, software solutions, consulting, e-commerce, global marketing.

I hope, my dear reader, that you have enjoyed reading Lifetime Scope Journal, and return back to this site every now and then. My promise is to deliver interesting topics and articles. If you, dear reader, would like to contribute LSJ with stories , backgrouders , etc. material please send them to editor board here.

Enjoy life

Lifetime Scope Journal (LSJ)

You may know TechCruch blog and the success story of it already. It is a great example of entrepreneur attitude combined with technology tools, marketing,  and visionary work.

Creating similar success stories is the scope of Lifetime Productions business concept. I think that the wealth of new applications in web 3.0 and semantic web are emerging.

There have been critics that social networking will make blogging less interesting to big audiences. Could be,  but digital lifestyle, lived to the fullest, will need rich variety of interfaces, applications, solutions, social and intellectual challenges that all together will make the digital lifestyle feeling cool.

Corporate blogging, in my opinion, is not going to loose its audience as long as the content and context served is current and interesting enough.

item.title: Consumer behaviour- the floating duck case
item.content:encoded:
I got the chance to participate Itella, a direct marketing corporation based in northern Europe,'s  Itella "Feedback Marketing" meeting in April 2007 where Andreas S. Weigend told the audience about his career with Amazon.com and his experiences  of customer behaviour and data processing. I here make some bits and pieces that from my notes and experiences of e-commerce 1.0.

After experiment the traditional E-Commerce 1.0 scenario with pieniomena.com shopping centre also some remarks come from my own experience of driving consumer behaviour.

The interaction between web 2.0 and e-commerce sites was the main reason to drop current solution of pieniomena(tm).com. Why should I pay 29 € for a site that has very limited functionality due the reason I had a "starter package" shopping centre? Secondly I have the burden finding and driving the traffic so that conversion rate is acceptable.


Thirdly I need to keep my customer registries etc. according the law (which costs), bank sell buttons are priced fixed, Adwords needs to be addressed with monthly payments and campaigns, print media used, stock of goods SCM organised and financed, etc., etc. The fixed costs of traditional e-commerce soon raise tremendously. In the end, as the E-commerce 1.0 salesperson said to me directly, many of these poor e-commerce entrepreneurs run out-of-business and money. What a way to make your living knowing the truth altheway


Ofcourse poor entrepreneurs are paying overheads for the more profitable customers, which everyone wishes to become. And there are indeed few good ones: MTV3store.fi for example. Owned by national broadcast company they have real advertisement advantage to pump up the ads daily in the TV network. This advantage has to create a successful e-commerce 1.0

So, what the heck. I sent closing notice. But only for e-commerce 1.0
pieniomena(tm).com brand is something Lifetime Oy Ltd. will continue to use and add value.
And I don't think open source - (OSCommerce.com or similar) solution would be that much more cheaper. Fixed costs stack is coming so many sources.
But of course for some of my existing products, mainly books, in stock I need to have sales channel.

Instead web 3.0 or semantic web world needs makes most important to make interactive, context aware corporate blogging pages. See also Anton Naumenko's great text about access control(previous entry).

The decision to drop current e-commerce solution was still a toughie. For computer engineer such as I, being the in charge for the e-commerce site feels great. It is great to log-on as DBA and move setting. Also when setting the pro package, priced around 60 € / mo the functionality of the shop becomes an advantage. But before getting the traffic to that level poor entrepreneur will not get.

I hope that this makes you think before putting the money in the e-commerce 1.0. The duck does not surf there. If you have a star product, again think again. Fortunately my backyard is not filled of truck loads of stuff ordered from china for e-commerce success.

Instead, Web 3.0, as Mr. Weigend names this in is his discussion,  means to me, that the supply chain and business process I want to orchestrate is not fully under my command. This also means that I have be professional player in all major web 2.0 services that bring value to my web 3.0 supply chain.

When the supply chain tree leafs touch my 'consumer' I need to find his and her likings so that this person decides to step toward this lifetime Scope and start reading. When this happens, the blog entry would need to include something that makes person to shop - and make revenue to my entity / supply chain. Perhaps you want now order the floating duck AND get some incentive from doing so (As customer should needs to rewarded with a bonus, not only the other participants).

So stepping out from traditional e-commerce means a huge step. And my need for solid consumer data grows even more.

What the consumer is doing today? Google, Amazon, MSN are in the know, so what can A poor boy do, but to play in the Rock and Roll Radio Road Show Band?

At least I dropped 29 $ / mo e-commerce costs. At least for time being. I closed a costs door.


Do leave feedback , please.

Thank You for being a lifetime friend;-)
