item.title: Getting ready for the Pitch:What is the Mission, Company goals and objectives for Lifetime OY Ltd?
item.content:encoded:
Hello Lifetime friends,

I was asked a week a ago to get ready for a VC people meeting. First feeling was excitement, since our first 18 years of work record for Lifetime OY Ltd. -The leading Finnish internet brand, has been a roller-coaster, and not always bed of roses. Sometimes I have been thinking, especially at the nineties, that we live in the wrong continent for anything to happen.

Nowadays, with companies Google, Yahoo, MSN, Amazon, Squarespace, Nokia, Web 2.0 , Lifetime OY Ltd. around I see that a change is happening globally, not only in the US. The globalisation will open totally new marketplaces and audiences. I know you are here already;-)

So my task in the meeting is to explain in three, five, or ten minutes for different investors 'tell me exactly why Lifetime Oy Ltd. is worth of the investment money, why the company is superior in it's operations to invest exactly to it, and do you walk the walk with an attitude? What is the exit bottom line?'

I'm feeling confident about liquidity of Lifetime Oy Ltd. Our Asset Management operations show rather good results for Q2 / 2007.  Many new enquiries are on the negotation table for consulting businesses resulting hopefully some lifetime customers. So there is even a possibility get more than 1 € / mo salary sometime before 2008.

 

Back to the pitch.

First question to clarify in the showroom is what is the Mission, Company goals and objectives for Lifetime OY Ltd? 

OK, first impression is very important, and I may need a new suit to look like superior. Then to the answer:

The mission: Our mission is delivering and ensuring great digital productions experiences for digital natives. We produce material of our own, we participate actively in web 2.0/3.0 communities and business operations, and we help companies to achieve their strategic goals through Lifetime Oy Ltd's advising and consulting services. We participate in innovative new launches and projects as a reliable partner and solution provider.

The Goal: Our goal is to grow profitable, consistent, responsible,passionate 200+ consultants global consulting and productions company serving customers globally.

The Objective is to create products and services that are above the customer expectation.

Outcome should yield to profitable, easy, laid-back corporation with people living their lifetime dreams come true. Our partners should enjoy being associated with us and they should prefer working with us.

We see that creating such communities, productions, services, messages, even code which digital lifestyle will require is real objective. The customers should feel and recognize the difference of our 'magic potion' brand in their digital lives as well. 

 

 

BTW: I have gathered excellent readings to Lifetime Gift Shop if you need help in your Pitch Presentation! Give them a try. Click Here

item.title: Partnership Business Model
item.content:encoded:
Your company finds a solution and you like the solution.
You like to run the solution and recommend it.
The solution vendor reaches his sales targets. They go work Partnerships.

The vendor offers you a incentive program.


You have reached a solution AND you are making money with the incentives.
Your sales, dear entrepreneur, peak as well. 

 

New partners sets in and it becomes a winning team community among the partners.

Black hats and black belts people are dedicating into. You hire black hats.

There is Disipline inside the community.

There is Respect to see the power of incentive Supply Chain.

VERSUS

You reach a solution

The solutions reaches you and messes up your business.

It puts latency to your work.

It cuts out the network.

And they send you the bill.

They succeed first. Best people can be beaten when there is no rules.

The pyramid of scammers have a party. They send you the marketing email.
Then the hype is suddenly over. The application team is fired. New people will be hired to create next pissing off.
The boss takes golden handshake and takes off.

The corporation has lost its window of opportunity.


What is your decision dear billionäire?

item.title: Aldata Oyj's solutions include G.O.L.D in retail, logistics
item.content:encoded:
Aldata Oyj in brief

Aldata Solution is one of the global leaders in Supply Chain software for retail, wholesale and logistics companies. The company's comprehensive range of Supply Chain Management and In-Store solutions enable its more than 300 customers across 50 countries to enhance productivity, profitability, performance and competitiveness. Aldata develops and supports its software through more than 600 Aldata professionals and a global partner network. Aldata is a public company quoted on the Helsinki Stock Exchange with the identifier ALD1V.

Aldata Solution is a leading provider of software solutions for the international retail, wholesale, manufacturing and 3rd party logistics sectors.

Aldata is a consistently growing company and supplies its software through its own subsidiaries in Finland, France, Germany, Slovenia, Sweden, Thailand, the UK, the US and Russia, as well as through its global partner network. Aldata has more than 300 installations in 50 countries.

Aldata's net sales for 2006 were €88.8 million and the company employed more than 630 personnel as at the end of December 2006.

Aldata Oyj's solutions include retail, logistics

Retail

Retailing is all about product, service and the consumer - enhancing services and ensuring product availability to meet the ever-changing requirements of the consumer. Aldata provides a full range of software solutions for retail and wholesale: master data management, merchandising and assortments, in-store operations, forecasting and replenishment, logistics and distribution, supplier and consumer management, all supported by a traceability backbone.

Whatever the type of Organisation - centralised, decentralised, franchise, ...., whatever the type of Sales channel - hyper, super, c-store, web, ...., whatever the type of product - food, CPG, textile, electrical, DIY, ...., Aldata's comprehensive retail and wholesale solution set enables you to calibrate Supply Chain to respond to consumer requirements.

Logistics

Logistics is the execution cornerstone of Supply Chain and is there to ensure optimised inventory levels and goods flows to meet your customers requirements. Aldata provides a full range of logistics solutions: warehouse management, warehouse voice operations, slotting optimisation, services invoicing, capacity planning, replenishment optimisation, network logistics, all supported by a traceability backbone.

Whatever the type of logistics operation - national, regional, cross-dock, ...., whatever the type of product - food, fresh, frozen, CPG, textile, electrical, DIY, ...., whatever the type of delivery - pallet, parcel, bar-code, RFID, Aldata's comprehensive logistics solutions set enables you to efficiently manage and optimise Supply Chain logistics to respect fully customer service levels.

Services

Aldata Solution and its global partner network provide a complete range of professional services - consulting, implementation, training and support – to ensure that Aldata solutions are implemented and deployed quickly and successfully. Based on many years of experience managing large global projects, Aldata Services deliver the right approach and execution in both planning and implementation quickly and economically.

Aldata has made significant investments in research and development (R & D) in recent years in order to remain one step ahead and to provide their customers with solutions which meet market demands and trends.

Aldata G.O.L.D. provides the means by which their customers can remain competitive, reduce complexity and automate business processes.

Aldata was founded in 1986. In 2006 as a retail solutions provider with global customers and global reach.

Key to the company’s success is focus on retailing. Customers recognise that they understand how retailing works and the challenges that the industry faces.

Through strong organic growth backed by strategic acquisitions, the company has developed a broad capability in international Supply Chain and store management.

Aldata shares are listed on the OMX Nordic Exchange in Helsinki. ALD1V. 

More information at: www.aldata-solution.com.

item.title: Does Advertisements add anything to your budget?

After two months of testing Google Adsense advertising (the two boxes with textual ads) below.first conclusions can be made about the results.

First impression about Adsense was that it brings added value to the Lifetime Scope Journal (LSJ). However, when carefully reading advertisements over time it seems, that not very many of you dear readers care about the adds. Google Analytics show, that average reader spends almost 20 minutes with Lifetime Scope Journal. He or she reads five or more entries, I get an impression that you dear reader must like our work since half of the you come back every now and then.

 
However it seems, that Lifetime Scope Journal (LSJ) does not mix very well with the Adsense links. Fairly I can say, that Google has setup the payment schemas so that every Adsense Exit means fair pay. I think that Google do great with semantically finding those 'grey'  associations for our production. The question is that the content seems to be more interesting to readers that getting to next best consultancy company around here. I do thank you for this, my lifetime friend!

Second ads we deliver comes from a ads network that pay only if something is shopped from the landing pages. These ads have resulted some cleared deals. I think great link is Cyberphoto.fi - one of the Sweden number one camera shops oneline - voted by Swedish consumers. I can honestly say it is close ( or steps ahead) what I had in mind with pieniomena(tm).com shopping centre..

To summarize, Lifetime Scope Journal is payed through Lifetime Consulting Fees 99 %. I do hope that you contact us for any possible projects that could fit our co-operation. We want to be trusted by our lifetime friends.

We like to continue this pleasure cruise with you!

We don't offer free drinking parties(22 years was enough), rather we want to show our commitment for stress less digital lifestyle made easy through our combined offerings with partners, colleagues, and foremost our customer - you.

item.title: MOSH, Forum Nokia, Widsets.com, Nokia Ovi
item.content:encoded:
What Exactly Is MOSH?

A user-generated content platform designed specifically for use with any mobile device. Create, upload, collect and share applications (like games, software mashups, videos, blogs, music and photos) all from your mobile.

How Can I Join MOSH?

 

Forum Nokia has membership levels that include yearly fees. This reminds me about my MSDN years. I got MCP'ed and all.
Great like HEL. Paying yearly fees is OK if you really develop applications. Otherwise it takes money and time with no results.

What we are going to do is setup Lifetime Scope Journal into Nokia WidSets Channel Program. Techorati is already there. So is TechCruch. Lifetime Scope Journal will be there. Stay tuned.

WidSets brings you information normally accessed via the Internet, directly into your mobile phone. Using mini-applications called widgets, it sends you updates made to your favorite websites. The system uses RSS feeds to push information from these websites directly into your mobile phone the minute theyre updated.

Many of our customers are already familiar with RSS, but those of you that arent can check out the What is an RSS feed? section under FAQ.

The best thing about WidSets is its simplicity. You simply install WidSets on your phone, select the widgets that interest you (or create your own in the Studio), and start using it. As soon as one of your chosen websites is updated (e.g. a news service, blog or weather forecast site), the widget for that website sends you an alert. Wherever you are, you are always kept up-to-date.

What is special about WidSets?

WidSets can be personalized. A feature unique to WidSets; facilitating user-generated applications through easy-to-use templates, so that any user - not just developers - can add a favorite website to WidSets.

One of the great things about WidSets is its ability to push content to your mobile phone as soon as it becomes available. You no longer have to use a web browser to find information. Instead, WidSets notifies you when new information is available.

WidSets vs. widgets?

By now youre probably wondering what the different is between WidSets and widgets. WidSets is the service you access via www.widsets.com and which you use on your mobile phone. Widgets, on the other hand, are the little boxes - or mini-applications – inside WidSets that fetch information for you from the internet.

What are WidSets main features?

  • Use widgets on your mobile phone
    Use WidSets to access your favorite RSS feeds, blogs, news or information service – texts and pictures. Or just play games and have fun.
  • Browse the WidSets Library
    Discover the vast collection of widgets available in the WidSets Library.
  • Personalize their appearance
    Create, personalize and tweak your widgets to suit your style and mood.
  • Create widgets and publish them in the Library
    Design your own widgets.
  • Audio alerts when a website has been updated
    A great way of ensuring you dont miss any new information on your favorite website.
  • Bookmark links straight from your mobile phone
    Use the Bookmark feature to create a link to the pages you come across via a widget. Use them later to find the website that the information came from.
  • Help develop WidSets
    Participate in the Forum and suggest improvements to the service.
  • Share interesting stuff with your friends
    Whenever you find something interesting, or a widget you particularly like – tell your friends about it.

How much does WidSets cost?

WidSets is absolutely FREE. And we definitely want to keep it that way.

But… your service provider may charge you for data transferred to your phone, i.e. for visiting websites or using data transfer services such as browsing the Internet. So, bear in mind that whenever WidSets conveniently puts information directly at your fingertips, you may be paying for it.

These costs depend on the contract you have with your operator. Contact your operator for data transfer costs. This is particularly important, as roaming (using another operators network, e.g. when traveling abroad) data costs can be pretty high, so its definitely worth looking into.

WidSets has a useful feature called Traffic Monitor which helps you monitor the total amount of data WidSets is using, and how much data each individual widgets is using. You can also set a limit for the amount of data transferred by your widgets and youll receive a notification when the limit has been reached.

What do I need to start using WidSets?

Very little. Youll need access to the Internet and a mobile phone that supports Java MIDP 2.0. If you are not familiar with Java MIDP 2.0, refer to the user manual for your phone, or the manufacturers website.

You will need to ensure that your mobile phone can connect to the Internet - you usually need a data subscription for your phone for this. If your phone has ever received an MMS (picture message) or a game, it is probably already set up to connect to the Internet and ready for WidSets. If your phone does not yet have Internet access, contact your network operator for assistance. Coverage may also vary depending on your operator and phone model.

If this all sounds very technical, dont worry, just give it a try. Sign up for FREE to WidSets, try downloading the WidSets client onto your mobile phone and follow the installation instructions. If it works, your phone supports WidSets!

Which cell phones support WidSets?

The best way to find out if your mobile phone supports WidSets is to try it out. Its free, so why not? Youll need a phone that supports Java MIDP 2.0 (most mobile phones sold in the last couple of years do) and that is able to connect to the Internet. Unfortunately WidSets is not yet compatible with Nextel or T-Mobile USA.

Were doing our best to make WidSets compatible with as many different phone models as possible. But with the constant flow of new phone models and new widgets, we are never going be able to test every widget on every phone model and every operators network. We are therefore really grateful for all feedback on how WidSets is working/not working on your particular phone model. Give your feedback in the Forum and well do our best to help you. Or, check to see if your question has already been answered.

A list of compatible phone models can be found at: http://www.widsets.com/devices.

How do I get started with WidSets?

Getting started couldnt be easier. Just follow these simple steps:

  • Go to www.widsets.com and select a few widgets that are of interest to you .
  • Then click on the Download the selected widgets to your mobile button.
  • Fill in your e-mail address, username and password and click OK.
  • Enter your phone number. (Dont worry, we hate spam too.) A text message will then be sent to this phone number, containing a link to the WidSets download page.
  • Select the link in the text message and your mobile phones web browser will open the WidSets download page.
  • Install WidSets - install the WidSets client on your phone from the folder you had downloaded it to.
  • Start using WidSets.

Alternatively, you can:

  • Download WidSets by entering get.widsets.com in your mobile phones web browser, and then download the WidSets client directly onto your mobile phone.
Or
  • Download the WidSets installation files to your PC from xxxxxxxxxx and transfer them to your mobile phone via Bluetooth, USB or similar. Then open the JAD file on your mobile.

More detailed instructions on how to sign up to the service, how to download the client onto your mobile phone, and tips on how to start using WidSets can be found in Getting Started under FAQ and under Tricks and Tips in the Forum.

How do I start using to WidSets?

 

Pick a few widgets from the WidSets home page, then click on the ´Download the selected widgets to your mobile´ button. Sign up to the service and we will then send you a text message, with which you can securely download the FREE WidSets client.

Next, follow the simple step-by-step instructions for downloading the WidSets client onto your mobile phone. Once you have done this, your account will be activated and you can start using the service.

Once you have done this, you can log in (on www.widsets.com) using the username and password.

What is a WidSets client?

 

The WidSets client is a mini-application. It is a window in your phone which is used to control widgets and to view the information contained in them. The WidSets client is installed on your phone and is later used to receive information when you are on the move.

How do I download the WidSets client onto mobile phone?

We will send a text message with a download link for the WidSets client to the mobile phone number you provided when you signed up to the service.

This could take a while, as this relies on your operator. We have done our best to use the best possible text message suppliers, but if for some reason you do not receive the link straight away, please be patient and wait for your operator to deliver it to your mobile phone.

If, however, it still seems as though nothing is happening, go to the ´Settings´ page on www.widsets.com and click the ´Reload´ button. This will send a new text message containing the download link. If that doesn´t help, use your phone´s web browser to download WidSets from get.widsets.com.

What should I do after downloading the WidSets client?

After downloading WidSets onto your phone, open it from the folder you stored it in. Most mobile phone models will have stored it in the ´applications´ folder or under ´Java applications´. Depending on which phone model you are using, the newly installed WidSets application may ask you for permission to access the Internet, this is necessary, so select ´yes´.

Running WidSets for the first time will activate your account and you´ll be able to start using WidSets.

Once you have done this, you can log in (on www.widsets.com) using the username and password.

WidSets Client: Full vs. Lite mode

WidSets comes in two modes: Lite, for older phones and Full, for phones with a higher processing power and more memory.

If you are experiencing problems using the Full mode version, try the Lite mode to see if it helps. And vice versa, if the Lite mode is performing well, try using the Full mode.

How do I start using WidSets on my phone?

When you open the WidSets application on your phone, you will see the widgets you chose on www.widsets.com. You will also see a WidSets system widget. In this widget you will find the Library, where you can browse the vast collection of widgets available, and the Inbox, where you will find news and information about the service, its updates and new features and messages from your friends that have WidSets.

You can search the Library for new widgets using tags or by category. There are also short-cut lists for the Latest, Most Popular and Slick Picks widgets.

You can start using your selected widgets straight away. We would however recommend that you check their settings first, to make sure that they are configured to your liking.

You can also create your own widgets in the ´Studio´ section of www.widsets.com. All widgets you choose from the Library or create in the Studio will be added to your WidSets Manager. Add new widgets to your WidSets Manager and then transfer them to your phone using the ´Synchronize´ button.

Here´s a brief introduction to the main features on www.widsets.com:

  1. Home - manage your widgets and transfer them to your phone.
  2. Library – browse all available widgets and select the ones that interest you.
  3. Studio - personalize your widgets using the Skin Editor, create new widgets and promote them on your website.
  4. Forum - find answers to your questions and participate in community discussions. Please get involved - we promise to give your ideas a try.

What character encoding does WidSets support?

WidSets currently supports Unicode (UTF-8 encoding). This means that WidSets works even if your mobile uses Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hebrew or Greek character sets.

What information can I find in the Forum section?

Ask questions, swap ideas, complain, discuss, help change WidSets - this is the place to voice your opinion and tell us how to make it better.

In the Forum section, you´ll find useful information about WidSets, widget development, phone-related issues, the future development of WidSets and practical tricks and tips on how to use the service.

Using WidSets

How does WidSets work?

WidSets is a mobile service keeping you up-to-date with the latest news available on the Internet, using widgets. By selecting various widgets from the widget Library, or by creating your own widget in the Studio, you can keep an eye on your favorite websites. Widgets send you information from RSS feeds, image galleries and your favorite web services. Why not set an audio alert on your widgets, to alert you whenever information on these websites has been updated? In addition to news and information, you can also play games and interact with your web communities, with your mobile phone.

What are the do's and dont's of using WidSets?

In order to make WidSets a pleasant experience for everyone, we have established a few do's and don'ts. Basically don't offend anyone - with abusive material or content that may be unsuitable for a public site.

Please read our Terms of Service. They'll give you a pretty good idea of what's allowed and what will get you banned. We have tried our very best to make them understandable to people other than law students.

What are widgets?

Widgets help you easily access information as soon as it's available on the Internet. They take the hassle out of trying to keep up-to-date with the enormous flood of information we are faced with every day.

Widgets use RSS feeds, something many of you have been using on the Internet for quite some time. But for those of you who aren't yet familiar with RSS, they 'push' information to your phone in the form of short descriptive links. You can then either read the brief description or download the entire content. Rather than having to first find a computer and then surf from site to site, you can have the information delivered straight to your mobile phone.

New widgets are constantly being developed, providing unlimited possibilities - not only do they deliver news updates to your phone, alert you when someone has posted a comment on your blog, inform you about a traffic jam, or deliver the latest gossip as soon as it's available, they also allow you to play games and interact with your web communities.

What is an RSS feed?

Websites that are constantly updating their information, such as news pages, use a service that generates a special 'feed' containing just the headlines. To receive this RSS feed, you need a 'client'. WidSets is a client. You tell WidSets which RSS feeds you are interesting in - we call them 'widgets'- and WidSets tells you when they have been updated.

It may sound a bit complicated, but it really is very simple. Instead of wading through all those newsletters or visiting websites, you just open your WidSets client and scan the headlines from your chosen widgets. If something catches your attention, click on the link and the full story will be displayed.

How can I change the RSS feed in a widget?

Configuring an RSS feed address is fairly straightforward. Websites with an RSS feed usually have a small 'RSS' or 'XML' logo on their home page. This is the feed's web address or URL, which you have to copy into your widget.

Copy the address into your widget by right-clicking on the logo and selecting 'Copy Shortcut'. Open the widget you want to modify and right-click to paste the URL into the RSS Feed URL box.

There is another, simpler, way of doing this. If you are using an Internet browser with an RSS reader extension (for example Firefox with the Sage RSS reader extension), you can simply drag and drop the RSS feed from the RSS reader into the widget's URL field.

What can I do in the Options-menu in the WidSet client?

The options menu enables you to manage your WidSets client, share widgets with friends, change the settings of individual widgets and send the content of a widget to your email address or Bookmarks folder.

Here are the key options on the WidSets client:

  • Send widget - if you think someone might be interested in WidSets or a particular widget, enter the person's phone number and send a widget directly to their phone. If they have never used WidSets, they'll also receive the download link for the WidSets client.
  • Connection - switch between the Http and Socket connections if you're having trouble connecting to the Internet with your WidSets client. The default setting is a Socket connection, but if your service provider doesn't support this form of connection, you may have to switch to Http.
  • Remove – this is a handy way of cleaning up WidSets and removing widgets that you never use. Removing idle widgets enhances the performance of your WidSets client.
  • Reload - this option refreshes the content of the selected widget, giving you the most up-to-date information available.
  • Settings - use alerts to notify you when a particular widget has been updated, or change the settings for switching between feeds in widgets with multiple feeds. Some widgets have content that is specified by tags, for instance tags for photo galleries or news topics. You can also specify whether you want to see images or the green plus sign as notification about updated content.
  • Send - use the 'send' option when you find something interesting. You can send the content straight to your Bookmarks folder or to an email address.
  • Help – here you will find simple instructions on how to use the WidSets client.

What are widget alerts and how can I use them?

Widget alerts can be set for each individual widget. When the alert is set to 'on', it informs you when the content of that widget has been updated.

To set an alert, go to 'Options' -> 'Widget' -> 'Settings' and select an alert from the seven alternatives. Widgets change visually when there is new content available.

There are a total of six audio alerts and one vibrating alert. The 'vibra' alert only works if your phone supports vibrating alerts.

You can adjust the volume of the audio alerts, on a scale of 1-5. If for some reason your alert function doesn't work, make sure the vibrating alert and warning tones are enabled on your profile.

What is the green plus sign shown on widgets all about?

If you see a green plus sign on one of your widgets, it means that there is new content available for that particular widget.

You don't even have to open your widgets to see if they have been updated!

How do I search for widgets in the library?

Our widget Library is constantly expanding. There is more and more information available every day and it is our job to make it as easy as possible for you to discover what is available. You can access the Library from your phone or from www.widsets.com.

Here's how you browse the Library:

  • Search - type in search words to narrow your search to specific topics
  • Categories – short-cuts to specific categories such as news, weather, etc.
  • Browse by tags - view the tag cloud of available widgets
  • Latest widgets - newest additions to the Library
  • Most popular - find out which widgets are most popular amongst WidSets users
  • Top rated - list of top-rated widgets in the Library
  • Slick Picks - check out the hottest downloads available on WidSets

For a full listing of available widgets, leave the search field blank.

How do I transfer widgets to my WidSets mobile client?

Once you are logged in (on www.widsets.com) and your WidSets client is connected (on your phone), select the widgets that are of interest. Then click on 'Synchronize' to transfer them to your phone. There is also a 'tooltip' function on this page (open by clicking on the ? in the top right-hand corner of the window) which will help you if you get stuck.

What can I do in the Studio section?

You will find several templates in the Studio for creating your own widgets. Change the way your widget looks, name it and give it an RSS feed address.

It's fast and easy. The Skin Editor is a great feature for personalizing your widgets. Just follow the simple step-by-step instructions or check out our Forum posting under 'Tricks and Tips' to learn exactly how to bring your widget to life by changing its style, icon, background color, etc.

If you have already created a widget for your website or blog, why not learn how to promote your widget? All you need to do is select a short script for your website's source code. Find out more under 'Promote Widgets'.

If you have some web development skills, you can also create a widget for your own web service in developer.widsets.com.

What is the Bookmark function used for?

Whenever you stumble across something interesting in a widget and you want to check it out again later, or just keep it for future reference, you can store it by clicking on the Bookmark.

Content which you have bookmarked from your mobile phone is stored under 'Bookmarks' on www.widsets.com – you must be logged in to access it. We love this feature - let us know what you think.

Managing WidSets

What is the Inbox used for?

Check the Inbox for updates, service announcements and new features in the WidSets service. This is also where you will find private messages, sent from other WidSets users.

Why would I want to keep track of traffic created by WidSets?

Your mobile phone operator charges you for all data transferred to and from your phone. So when WidSets conveniently provides you with information, you may be paying for it. We suggest you contact your operator for their data transfer prices.

We help you keep track of your WidSets traffic with our Traffic Monitor. It is a very useful tool and can be combined with the Traffic Reminder, a tool which sends a reminder to your phone when you exceed your preset traffic limit. Please note that slight deviations may occur.

What settings can I configure in WidSets?

Go to www.widsets.com and log in. Click on ‘Settings’. You will now be able to change your profile information, including your email address, phone number and password. If for some reason WidSets isn’t working properly, you can reload the WidSets client onto your phone or delete your WidSets account.

 

Update on 2008-01-15 12:20 by Editor in Chief, Lifetime Studios

What exactly is MOSH?

What exactly is MOSH?

MOSH is a content sharing site where community members upload, distribute and manage content to be viewed and enjoyed on mobile devices. With MOSH, anything from applications like mobile games, to videos, blogs, songs or photos are now accessible and distributable on your mobile device.

How does it work?

There are three key elements to MOSH:

  1. 1. A website
  2. 2. A mobile website
  3. 3. An application for mobile devices (available for download on Nokia devices only)

The website is your main source for accessing the wide range of content available through MOSH. It is here where you can create your profile, upload content, manage your collections and specify which selects to send to your mobile device as mobile feeds.

The mobile website is where users with both Nokia and non-Nokia devices can access mobile feeds and view the MOSH service.

The application allows users quick access to MOSH from their Nokia device.

Copyrights of MOSH belongs to Nokia Corporation 2008.

item.title: Public Procurement in Finland
item.content:encoded:
Adapted from http://www.kunnat.net/k_etusivu.asp?path=1;161;122591

About 15 % of GDP (22,5 billion euros) in Finland is spent by the government, municipalities and congregations on the procurement of goods, services and public works. Finnish public procurement is subject to national procurement legislation which derives from the European Community directives on public procurement. Under these rules public sector procurement must follow transparent open procedures ensuring fair and non-discriminatory conditions of competition for suppliers.

The regulation of public procurement aims at a more efficient use of public funds in order to ensure value for money on public procurement financed out of general taxation. A further aim of the regulation on public procurement is to enhance the competitiveness of national and European enterprises. When procuring goods, services or works the contracting authority must take advantage of existing market conditions and improve the functioning of markets.

Public procurement is closely regulated.

The procurement process usually follows the following pattern:

  1. Planning of the procurement
  2. Publication of a prior information notice
  3. Setting up a specification and other substantive requirements
  4. Publication of a contract notice
  5. (Exclusion of candidates)
  6. Sending the invitations to submit a tender
  7. Receiving tenders
  8. Opening of tenders
  9. Verification of the suitability of tenders sending companies
  10. Evaluation of the contents of tenders
  11. Choosing the winning tender 
  12. The decision on public procurement
  13. Notification of the decision and the instructions for appeal
  14. Concluding the contract
  15. Publication of a notice of the results of the award procedure
The winning organisation will
  1. Finding suitable subcontractors
  2. Evaluating suitable subcontractors
  3. Verification of the suitability of subcontractors
  4. Project Management Activities:Nominating Project Steering Group
  5. Nominating Project Manager
  6. Running the project..

item.title: The SCM of tenders in public orders
item.content:encoded:
Change in EU's legislation of how official projects will need to meet market competition though invitation for tenders  is changing SME's networking strategy and Supply Chain Management of tenders.

In June 2007, When the public tender limit were lowered (now all projects that exceed 15.000 euros) the supply chain of tenders changed the game. This means to SME's that more projects can be offered without creating combined tender with clustering partners.

It is very good news for most of the SME since setting up combined offer with competitor can take resources and leave negative bottom line. The game of setting up a combined tender takes legal consideration, more heavy project organisation etc. It all means costs, costs, costs.

This is also good news for Lifetime Consulting. When you plan to answer those tender invitations we may help you to finish up winning and get 'em projects into your house. You simply order Lifetime Project Manager with hourly fee to do the project management. Or you may want to use our specialist service to add technical data to your tender.

Setting up a tender portfolio for that fits your company strategy can be done with a little help of Lifetime Advisor level professionals.

So the Supply chain for tenders is now clearer for you , dear Entrepreneur. With good supporting act, like Lifetime Consulting, you can get results that bring in the winning solutions and customers.

item.title: Lappeenranta University of Technology final round
item.content:encoded:
I heard today that all my courses are finally (hopefully they are all in) in and accepted.

I got an early promise to get papers out from school 30th of AUGUST, 2007.

;-)

It has been a pleasure cruise of 30 months studying, running newspapers at night, building Lifetime Oy Ltd. at days. I have had a 10 days of holiday last weeks over the period. Broke my Mercedes to a tree, and divorced to live entrepreneur to the fullest. Car will be fixed, new people will be found. New customers will appear.perkele.

Somehow I think I'm still in wrong country. There is so much bullshit of pre-seed money and help which seems to so far from my operations. Convincing someone to lend me money with interest rate of 70 percent PA. Get out of here! Why 15 percent is not good enough my dear angel?(yeah - the saviour).

Secondly I get a email weekly from EU convincing EU is helping SME's with everything.

I see great conferenses, great pdf shows. I don't see one page apply form to setup a innovation into project. If it is somewhere I don't find it. Where is it? 50%-100% project funding including hire of teams for hottest web 2.0 applications Europe and the world would love to have.' Your fired!

And then there finnish technology evangelists,like tekes, who hope that I (entrepreneurs) will invent next Nokia.  I need to write 100 pages of business plan to apply 40k €. Thanks for the snacks. What can one poor boy do with 40k? Not form a rock and roll band. Nothing. Getting ready for the Angel deal, which never should be accepted. This looks good in the goverment summary page.

In the end Nokia become software? 

Even when Nokia is exactly executing similar toward software oriented strategy that I am, what the heck I'm not doing right. Where is the money.

item.title: Learn More About Personal Identity Provider (PIP)
item.content:encoded:
What is PIP?

Personal Identity Provider allows you to manage your personal information online by providing a single sign on to multiple websites. PIP also provides the flexibility to share only the information you choose with each website.

When you create a PIP account, you will receive a personal identifier in the form of a URL that you can use to sign in or register at any site that supports OpenID.


Manage your online identities with PIP

Use PIP to protect your information and share it with sites you trust. You can set PIP to track what sites you have shared your information with and for how long. You can choose to stop sharing information with a site you no longer trust.



How to use PIP

Click Sign Up for PIP below to create a PIP Account. You will receive a personal URL that you can use on sites that show the OpenID logo.
 
 


From the same browser you used to sign into PIP, visit one of the many sites that support OpenID and type or paste your URL into the Sign in area. Using your PIP URL makes it easy to register for a new account, or sign in to your existing accounts.

If the site you are registering for requests information, you can choose which information you would like to share or keep private.




What is the SeatBelt Extension?

SeatBelt is a Firefox plug-in that assists you when signing in to OpenID sites with your PIP URL. Typically, if you are not signed into your PIP account when you access a sign in page using OpenID, you need to access your PIP account and sign in. Since you must do this within the same browser window, you have to navigate away from the page you wish to sign in to.

SeatBelt detects that you have clicked on an OpenID sign in field while not signed into your PIP account and prompts you to sign in. Once you have signed in, SeatBelt automatically returns you to the OpenID sign in page with your PIP URL filled in. The sign in session continues as normal.


What is the icon SeatBelt added to my browser?

When you install SeatBelt, it adds an icon to the upper right corner of your browser. When not signed on to your PIP account, the icon is gray.


When you are at the PIP sign in page, the icon is green.


When you are signed in to your PIP account, the icon is yellow.


Click on this icon to access your PIP account.

item.title: Firstbeat Mobile Coach will take you there if youre phone is not hijacked
item.content:encoded:
Let me start by saying the all new Firstbeat Mobile Coach training software is a great innovation I have no question about it. The  software is used by McLaren F1 team and the Finnish National skiing Team for example. I downloaded the software and will get back to the usage experiences later on. ASICS software has helped me so far, but something more integrated is needed.

My concerns are outside of this software itself.

I bought a new phone to our kid this Christmas, which include Bluetooth connectivity to share music and stuff between children. This is fine, but I'm somewhat worried as a parent about the consequences of bad Bluetooth implementation. When reading F-Secure blog you learn about the bluetooth hijackers that were there waiting to connect to your mobile. The all new protocol of Bluetooth is obviously safe. Or is it? What happens when it breaks, like every software products sometimes does?

What kind of studies is there to settle my self that nothing happens with an open bluetooth phone? There is hundreds of kids running with these new toys to school this spring. I adviced my kid to shutdown the Bluetooth UNLESS he is sitting with his friend to send the music. And shutdown the Bluetooth again immediately. Paranoid ? Could be , but to be honest 20 years in software engineer has opened my eyes. You could add F-Secure Mobile Internet to the phone? It's 40 euros per year per kid.

Who updates the software? Papa. Is it turned on or off? Does the other kid have security? And they are only 10! Sorry but we are late from basketball training AND then ..

As a father Im responsible about the Bluetooth stack(Thanks Microsoft for fixing TCP-IP today..) of my kids. And it hurts in my tooth already. There is no easy cure. The Symbian intelligent platform is evolving very rapidly. When I do need to update my children phone OS. Once in a month patch tuesday? What happens earlier Monday? I don't like mondays..

If something happens, well you're hurt anyway. Proving that the responsible company is that or this does not help you personally.

Lost your business plan and data with open Bluetooth or broken application? You can prove it . Can you stand the court expenses? What year the settlement with M X will be approved?  Using paper and pencil and independent consultant is working solution for some companies.

The similar issue is with Mobile Coach training software. Using it's high tech features as an unexperienced trainer with a phone that has been attacked? Well, it obvious who will be hurt. Run 100km's in a day. hmmmm. I can do that! Really a thin client solution.

Secondly the usage of mobile phone in the gym: I don't want to walk with my phone from one training machine to the another, running , or cycling class with my phone. Then 50 people forget their phones, there is sweat and water bottles and thieves. What a mess ! It seems already that the etiqette of no phones in the gym is violated and this makes it even worse.

The only real interface I accept is somekind of transmitter like is in Suunto and FRWD training meters. The best idea is embed this trasmitter(s) to the intelligent clothes like NIke and Adidas is already doing. 

These embedded transmitters wearable computers, are the interface for me. Mobile phone is not. What if I swim or take Triathlon challenge? Do I take my Amazon Kindle with me? I bet iPhone has solved this.

As conclusion (Free advice from Lifetime Consulting Services - considering a new project hire us!)

1. I would like to buy this Firstbeat Mobile Coach innovation software. And I propably end up doing so after two weeks of thesting.

2. I like to have good wearable trasmitters. The technology is ready out in the stores, but the learning curve is still there.

I will get to this later on.

3. I like to have a real personal trainer to do the program like it is today to make sure I'm still doing right things.

4. I called my dentist already. He welcomed me and is sure happy of returning customer.

 


 

 

/journal/2007/12/19/lifetime-oy-ltds-business-blog-media-cards-released.html

More readers will mean more possibilities for a business owner or marketer to launch successful marketing campaigns and win market share for new products with business blogs. fact.

item.title: Put me in coach!
item.content:encoded:
Dear Entrepreneurs, consultants, friends, enemies, investors, girl friends (ex or future), coaches, hireing consultants, kids, business partners, writers, bloggers, musicians, actors, film makers, managers, ministers, executives, help personnel, dogs, cats, tractors, old cars, and the rest of you.

I think 2008, after three years studying of new in Lappeenranta University of Technology and forgetting the old (I'm sorry for my bad and bitter language sometimes, please forgive me), myself and my company are ready to play. I have a feeling that this year does not start me and my family up a recession but turns a new page of good, meaningful life. We will save this planet together. I want to contribute my 20 working years ahead to accomplish this as well. Lifetime Oy Ltd. can be one channel, or any other organisation as well.

When I was a kiddie myself I was coaching other kids in basketball team Pussihukat. From those times I have kept the love for the game (basketball in my case) and for active sports life. When Scottie Pippen visited Finland last week, I suddenly identified what I have been missing for almost 7 rough years. Joy of life. Thank You Scottie for visiting Finland. I know there are many friends, ex-players, coaches all over Europe that can share this feeling. It was so nice to have you here.

I hope we see Dream Team revisited in Europe in coming years. I hope Finland is chosen to your game schedule!

Many of my kiddie days players I have met many of us in the linkedin.com and facebook.com. There is many that I hope to see again soon.

You know this song already, listen again, at least I have missed this feeling last 7 years. 

Let's start 2008 promising next seven years will be more enthusiastic and passionate to whatever we are, and whatever bridges we need to cross. And let's remember those of us that did not make it this far. I appreciate your friendship. Thank You.

Risto

Lifetime Scope Editor (LSJ)

item.title: closing 30.000 working hours
item.content:encoded:
This week I will continue to seek new customers and partners. Yesterday I read a interesting story about how much work oneself needs to do to excel in something, to become a real Professional. In this article a common claim was presented that around 10.000 hours of, that is 5 years of fulltime work, per one professional role will make you good enough.

I Started to think my work and study career so far. I ended somewhere around 30.000 working hours as an IT Software Engineer(10k), Project Manager(10k+), and the rest in Consulting Advisor Role. To become a professional international serial Entrepreneur and Consulting Advisor I calculate that more 2.000 hours is still needed. That is my honest estimate. I promise a little discount for those 2.000 hours when you mention it as our valued Lifetime Oy Ltd's Customer.

My 30.000 hours does not count full-time studying in the Universities and Tech Schools, which are a worth of their own analysis some of this days. 

What are your figures? Are you happy with your current career? I sure hope you are. 

Have a great day.

Lifetime Scope Journal (LSJ)

item.title: Google Adsense becomes business blog intelligent and mobile
item.content:encoded:
After 8 monts with Google Adsense I have found out the same as every business blog editor. Adding Adsense ads is foremost question of the place. If Ads are place in the corner of the page very little traffic is turned to activity.

Another issue is that placing Google ads manually and editing the text to fit the ads is time consuming and often without pay

Google Adsense is beta testing new functionality to uses context related alternative.

With Amazon.com context sensitive ads things are little easier for the maintenance, but problem with Amazon.com context sensitive ads is it fills all text with Amazon.com ads.

Or again you have edit entries at code level, which is not PAY task for LSJ traffic.

Let's hope the easy usage of Context sensitive ads combined to somekind of tool to visually set ads area to particular chapter of the text will be the end results

One thing also: Let me easily to throw all Adsense money to Adwords account

Lets drive the (advertising) economy. Thanks Google!

item.title: Creating Ubiquituos Web solution withI Google Knol
item.content:encoded:
Google Knol is invitation based site. Its information is based on specialist or gu ru entries. Knol prefer in-depth material to make Automated ads more valuable. It will add intelligence to the internet with concept called ubiquitous Web.

it is there to see wether it's importance will overall make Knol a competitor to Wikipedia.org.

Google Corporation's new Beta Program Knol offers by invitation fresh start-up new Wikipedia.org type semantic web information tool.

"Earlier this week, we started inviting a selected group of people to try a new, free tool that we are calling "knol", which stands for a unit of knowledge. Our goal is to encourage people who know a particular subject to write an authoritative article about it. The tool is still in development and this is just the first phase of testing" announces the Official Google Blog.

This process will close to my opinion one chapter of blogging. If a blog only references other information sources it disadvantage of such blog is that information is without doubt subjective. On the other hand, if your authority is high enough this subjective approach is not a bad thing. But for some bloggers that write only to do Adsense marketing this will be end of chapter?

The Business Blogging Momentum is 2008


The Business Blogging project includes company strategy tied information and products and services tied information. This kind of 'informative' information is always taking sides. With tools like Knol it may become possible to add the big picture more easily to the company business blog. It creates trust and helps reader to place available information in to the right context.

Objective semantic web is a dream that open source gurus will dream on. I fact, how objective is the information found in the current wikipedia.org entries? Who is authoring the objective writings panel?

My estimation is that also other major players in the industry will create their own objective semantic web as well. Keeping people at their reach as much as possible gives best performance to advertising and sales efforts.

With business blogging initiative any company can create global voice that can influence their own industry and local many-to-many business network as well. To support this and make the spear heads of information linking company blog to Knol and Wikipedia.org will enlarge the reach of the business blog, but also gain more authority to the business blog.

Goodbye email and spam, welcome Knol and it's fresh ideas. New worlds are welcome and needed to increase credibility of business blogging as well.

 

Lifetime Scope Journal Editor

Risto Päärni

item.title: Digital Marketing is more than thinking of choice of digital channels
item.content:encoded:
I had a chance to have a quick read of Finnish Economica series book about Digital marketing written by (Merisavo, M, Vesanen, J. Raulas, M. Virtanen, V., digitaalinen markkinointi, 2006 Talentum Oyj).

Writers handle topic professionally and thoroughly , though I bet they would write much better version of the book if released 2007. Things are moving so fast. The book covers a short chapter about web 2.0. The main focus is in characteristics and usage of different digital channels.

The idea from the book that was presented that digital marketing is like pushing messages though diffrerently positioned and performing digital channels, like email, newsletters, blogs, etc. This type of Marketing Management, according my read and experiences,  etc. is highly undervalued in Europe compared to US.

The book presents solid and real customer and business cases worth digging into.

The idea I was getting from the book is that digital marketing management is about effectively using these push channels. Equally important for Customer Relations Management is the that loyal customers living their digital lives have communities that reflect their lifestyles and consumer preferences.

The push of a marketing message is needed. After that, once that precious customer is found, you dear entrepreneur want to keep her for life. To  start building your brand and to add loyalty you can ask consultancy and project management from Lifetime Oy Ltd.- The leading  Finnish internet brand since 1989.

Now that we digital natives live with web 2.0 based solutions, like cool new Google Desktop 4.0, based on gadgets like those good old Unix window platform in the 1980's, the focus of new venture money race has to see the possibilities of community based consumer liberation. And yes, like TechCruch today tells us, new seed funding of 2M USD was granted to diettv.com - a health service community. Wether it is venture seed money or Marketing Managers budget doesn't matter. The Digital Marketing and the new 2.0 innovations are cool for everyone.

 

I had similar health related business idea 2005, and asked money from Finnish seed company 2006, but they said no. This is BTW quite typical Finnish venture management . Ideas are not taken seriously in  time. This is a major difference between US and EU venture investments policy for Venture money. So drop your business card when you want to invest 2M to Lifetime Oy LTd. as well. We run the run.

Oh, back to the book: Excerpt from the Introduction of book Digital Marketing:  Future customer will use  more and more internet and the digital channels. He is interactive with the marketeer and other customers. The book answers following questions (Translated freely, sorry friends).

1. Who is today's interactive Customer?

2. How can a Marketeer answer the call of active and competent customer's expectations.

3. Which Strategy differentiates our offering fro the competitors?

4. How digital marketing operations are executed within the chosen marketing strategy.

See Digitaalinen markkinointi homepage at Digitaalinen markkinointi homepage from Talentum

Forum Nokia 18th of July Newsletter with co-operation of Lifetime Brands Program(tm)

"Nokia is pleased to launch the Mobile Rules! Competition, the leading annual competition for mobile applications and business plans. The goal of this effort is to bring together the most innovative thinking on applications, services and business models. Business managers, entrepreneurs, developers and creative professionals can benefit from this engagement and will have a chance to get products and services into the hands of millions of Nokia device users, operators, integrators, and enterprises. Multiplayer/Connected Games, Multimedia, Enterprise Infotainment

Applications will be judged on uniqueness, design, ease of use, and the overall consumer experience. Don't let the categories restrict your thinking. Innovative applications and business plans that combine technologies and operate across these categories will also be considered.

Internet Innovation
Mobile Sharing
Very Human Technology
Green Businesses


The main focus of the business plan competition is communication and sharing. Plans are judged on their uniqueness, value to consumers, market potential, customer adoption, revenue opportunity and investor value.

item.title: Lifetime Oy Ltd's Innovation Management Process use portfolios
item.content:encoded:
First Edition: Why a good business idea is not worth anything, nor it is an innovation?

 

When I was sitting in lectures of Innovation Management in Lappeenranta Univ. of Technology one sentence catches me " a good idea is not worth anything. Innovation Management means that you have to commercialize that idea before you can call it innovation".

Indeed, reading stories from Business Angels decision making of which ideas are funded - which not, gives similar results.

According business angels, a good idea is often invented many times, sometimes simultaneously,  in all over the global innovation playgrounds.

Example situation: Innovation in The Game Industry. The winner has to have

1. Suitable infrastructure for innovation management

2. Right contacts with 0-latency for setup phase. Own and hire Super-connected People with ability code.

3. The credibility to launch the innovation project in the industry.

4. Minimum of 50k Euros for run two people for one year. Govermental Verso Program from TEKES can help another 50k Euros. But don't wait them to do so. Finding next 5m€ in six months to setup from the demo to planning phase.

5. Production phase funding

6. Market Entry funding

-free to use, pay to customize.

The example of casual games have many innovations that has followed similar path.

The difference of successful innovation and a good idea is the successful planning layering,Actual Project Management, especially resourcing:  the people, process and its owner. To play big from the scratch. And doing it right. Even more important is to secure your innovation with Immaterial rights policy and solutions like patents and trademarks. 

Jussi Nurmio, CEO of taivas Corporation and real estate service Igglo, discusses about the theme in  digital Taloussanomat.  He concludes " Every innovation has to have one owner who believes about the innovation . Secondly there has to be a partners that believe to the innovator and is capability to execute the business plan of the innovation."

Being a business angel has to start from creating an innovation portfolio where most of the innovations may turn out to be failures, but the successful ones will bring enough profits to continue in business with a good profit.

Like Drucker said "There is only two activities in a company: Marketing and innovation".

What is wrong in Finnish innovation world is that the business angels are rather investors with a tight bottom line control instead of  a innovation portfolio owners. The governmental money seems to be more interested to keeping seminars for each others and creating small town project managers with political links than global success stories. According WWW.TEKES.FI  the whole innovation funding scheme will be changed 2008. I hope they read this story too.

The innovation build-up process would need the professional entering the SME in the idea phase, not after 'project ready to launch' phase.  Running down for layers of filtering is costly and requires real professionalism.

That is because also you, dear entrepreneur, need to have  4 layers of Innovation Management. 

The schema in Lifetime Oy Ltd. include these layers.

1. Ideas portfolio

  • The fuzzy Front-End of Innovations
  • Time-window
  • IPR

2. Innovation Portfolio

  • Business Angel and investor perspective
  • Techical can-do
  • Preventing errors

3. Business plan Portfolio

  • 4P Marketing Mix
  • Marketing Management
  • Sales Management
  • Promotion

4. Operational Project Management Portfolio

  • Critical project path
  • Ensuring business success
  • Running the last mile to customer loyalty

With these four portfolios and with help of Consulting Advisor service from Lifetime Oy Ltd. you dear Entrepreneur, SME business owner, will become more successful and the business more profitable.

No man can be put to 100% responsible for one idea execution, is the question. I will failure 95%, like the business angel do as well!  But using four stages portfolio model I at least recognize that one idea will filtered at all of these portfolios before conversion to profits is here.

item.title: Lifetime Scope Special Edition: The Gphone Fact Book Update 10/02/07
item.content:encoded:
Lifetime Scope Special Edition: The Google's gPhone Fact Book

 

Everything you need to know about the gPhone and

The New Mobile Industry 2.0 for Digital Natives.

 

The Google mobile initiative changes the wireless industry operator model

into a blue ocean business model delivering digital lifestyle to everyone.

 

The Google initiative boosts the competition for the whole Digital Lifestyle Supply Chain.

 

Background 

 

Apple's iPhone has been the biggest mobile industry entry in 2007 so far.Nokia's new multimedia computers like N81 and Ovi are setting new standards for mobile industry. Third major paradigm shift will be set by search engine giant Google Corporation by its Gphone initiative. New mobile operators, f.e. Blyk, are bringing free SMS's and voice services to communities and carefully selected segments- like teenagers.
 
The proposed Deal for Google from Lifetime Scope Editor

1. Re-organize the Supply chain of digital lifestyle globally:(i.e. content provider, mobile operator, phone maker, network operator, advertiser, co-branding, community, customers,markets, etc.),
 
2. lower customers phone bills with google Adwords advertising, low-cost phones, and Google applications including Gpay.
 
3. Take charge to Mobile Network Services as well. Co-Branding and licensing.
 
4. Drive customers and internet traffic where you want to with the new platform and applications
 
5. Invest heavily to best Content Services, since they commit in the end company's long-term revenue.
 
Lifetime Scope Journal (LSJ) will follow the Success Story of Gphone Blue Ocean with mashups of all Internet media. LSJ will follow up Google's mobile initiatives emerge on daily basis.Keep your subscriptions alive.

Lifetime Scope Journal (LSJ) will be your all-you-need source to keep on track with the news, widgets, gadgets, and more for Gphone, Ovi, Yahoo Mobile, Zune, iPhone, Blyk, and more. 
 

Quotes in NYSE: (GOOG) Apple in NYSE: (AAPL) Microsoft (MSFT),Yahoo (YHOO), Nokia (NOK), Palm (PALM)

Google Platform

 

According sources, Google is preparing a new mobile platform, a rival to the Nokia preferred Symbian OS, Microsoft's Windows Mobile, mobile Linux, Palm, and other mobile operating systems.

(Adapted from BusinessWeek.com 09/06/07):" "The new operating system, which may be named gPhone, was developed in part with know-how Google acquired with a startup named Android in 2005. The platform is designed to enable lower-priced "smartphones" featuring more robust Web browsing and multimedia applications. Most importantly for Google, it will work hand in glove with the company's mobile search engine and other Google applications that are already popular on personal computers. Gphone will allow Google to bring new applications to the wireless market faster. A number of handset makers are prototyping of lower-cost phones based on the Google platform. These handsets, expected to sell for about $100, are being shopped around to carriers worldwide, including those in the U.S. On top of the lower price tag.Google also hopes to attract customers with lower monthly cell bills"(End of quote).

(Adapted from 08/24/07 http://www.rediff.com)Talks are believed to be taking place with Bharti Airtel [Get Quote] and Vodafone Essar, respectively India's first and third largest mobile telephony operators, and state-owned Bharat Sanchar Nigam. Sources close to the development said a simultaneous launch across the US and Europe is expected, and announcements would be sent to media firms in India and other parts of the world. US regulatory approval, which is expected soon, is the only hurdle that Google is waiting to cross, they added". (End of Quote). Google plans to invest $8-10 billion for its Gphone initiative.

Customers will have to agree to receive ads on their mobile phones.In Blyk business model currently running Great Britain, 6 advertisements is sent daily to customer phones. To get Blyk, a friend has to recommend new member to the community.(Compare to BLYK.COM).(taloussanomat 25.9.07)
 

Patents 

Google has applied for a patent for a mobile payment system [5] to complement its 'plans to launch' [6] the Google phone, or GPhone. Known as 'GPay' [7], it covers a system that would let the user send a text message to Google giving the details of a payment to a specified recipient. GPay then debits the user's bank account, crediting the money to the payee(wikipedia.org).
 

My humble prediction is, that Google will attempt to introduce a new blue ocean business model, not only for the wireless-services industry, but to the digital lifestyle consumers end-to-end. You walk the digital walk, Google will send you the goodies along the way.

In 2006, Google Corp. generated $10.6 billion in revenue from online search advertising with a 62.7% market share. In mobile market today, Microsoft and Yahoo are currently the market share leaders.

It is expected that Mobile Windows platform will ship more than 20 million devices in 2007.

Yahoo's new Mobile search engine, oneSearch, has been a success story. Opera browser is using OneSearch.

While 15% of U.S. mobile users have browsed Web pages on their mobile phones, only 3% have used a mobile search engine.

Google's new blue ocean business model will appeal to the carriers as they struggle to boost revenues in 'bit-pipe-markets' where the price competition is fierce and predicted revenues will start to fall 2010.(Re-organize)

Blyk's Business Model:give subscribers discounts for agreeing to receive and follow ads on their phones. Google will succeed in bringing a lower-priced phone to the market, the gPhone could have some broader impact than the iPhone, which still costs $400.

With free Web-surfing and search capabilities, business model fill a void in developing markets where many people can't afford, or the to Enter market Niches and communities - like teenagers.

The main goal for Google and its competitors is to provide mobile platform that smoothly integrate all their applications and digital storages to have full control over customer digital lifestyle.


Launching a new operating system Google's advantage is the limited number of applications that will be available for that platform.Google will have full control over the user experience.Google will ensure the success with lower phones bills.

Symbian and Windows Mobile's advantage is rich application ecosystem.There are thousands of third-party  applications to choose from and more being written by software developers every day. This has meant expensive devices and applications for the end users. It is interesting to see wether Gphone really changes the Mobile SCM for the benefit of our digital lifestyles.

In August 2007 Nokia unveiled a new suite of mobile Internet services called Ovi. 

Microsoft's iniative is new a phone version of its Zune music player.

Windows, Zune is trademark of Microsoft Corp. Gphone is trademark of Google Corp. OneSearch is trademark of Yahoo Inc.
Ovi is trademark of Nokia Corporation. Blyk is a trademark of Blyk Inc.

item.title: Lifetime Oy Ltd. fills the 'planning gap' with Ansoff's strategies
item.content:encoded:
An interesting aspect of strategic management is the development of specific strategies for achieving company objectives. Strategies must respond to the environment of the company and provide specific guidelines for decision-making in operational management. Lifetime Oy Ltd.'s strategy can be viewed as example case.

Ansoff's 'planning gaps or 4P gaps' is classic theory of aiming the company objectives with set of strategies. Organisations seeking to grow by gaining a larger market share in their current industry or market follow a penetration strategy.

Lifetime Oy Ltd. specializes in Consulting including digital brand building, building digital assets with Web services and business blogs, produces services of digital productions, and advisor services including IT consulting, professional project management and IT specialist team member services. Lifetime Oy Ltd. markets are among growth companies that need to market their innovations to the global consumers.

To close product gap company must increase market share on current markets with current products

OR

increase product share by increasing frequency of use, increase quantity used, new models and applications.

Secondly company has overcome price gap. This can be reached through new products and innovations.

Distribution gap can be solved with diversification strategy, where new products are introduced to new market according the strategy.

Promotion gap can be filled through carefully evaluating the market potential in the whole including all segments. In the B2C market it is often achieved by determine the maximum potential individual usage and then extrapolating this by the maximum number of potential consumers.

"The Customers of Lifetime Oy Ltd's consulting Customers read business blogs and consumer digital productions on daily basis. They actively participate in various internet based activities. They modern, mobile world citizens whose income is usually above the national average level. Their accept new solutions and services as evitable evolution. They love to revolutionaze markets, products, market shares, marketing advantages, and therefore are powerful consumers. And they know it." 

To really find needed strategic solutions to solve all 4P gaps company Sales can be met by good strategy work, and and setting the sales objectives in the marketing plan realistic and achievable.

item.title: Value chain that hurts
item.content:encoded:
When someone grasp a profit or benefits from someone's other's life with creating a negative value chain, it is basically and fundamentally an immoral action.

When the negative consequences break legal aspects. it is illicit.

Some examples of negative value chain cases and argumentation:

1. When a company lays you off or violate your company's agreement because they like your idea and are not willing to fairly pay you, in a moment of greed, that is negative value chain to you (or your company). It is not ok to say "we did it for more noble purposes, and that's why we did not compensate the original idea owner".

2. When a public servant i.e. minister decides to drop a pension pay rate when feeling  for a that strategically agile day "what is right" that is negative value chain. It does not matter that the pension is legally accepted by a doctor statements.

3. When a different politically oriented group decide make a market research, and ask "have you had ever a feeling about the issue", and when 60 % of the answerers say they have felt so, it is a negative value chain to publicly execute someone because of the felt opinion, if nothing illicit has not been happened.

4. When a network operator,who your company is paying, has access to your documents, and finds your business plan from the server, a creates new version of your site and business plan, that is a negative value chain. It is not ok by announcing " IPR's are too expensive to fight in the court".

5. It is negative value chain when you want to create a good name, but this is manually replaced with bad search results. It is not OK to do!

6. It does not help you that this site around your idea is build with big money. It doesn't make things justified to say "I stole some, but I forgive me".

7. It is illicit to steal immaterial property of other individual. It will remain that way even if you end up a millinonaire. It is immoral if you just copy the ideas to your linkedin.com CV?

8. If your boss cannot stop you taking a position in the company, but he decide not to support in the work in any way just waiting you to collapse or resign, that is a negative value chain. It is not corrected by saying "We are not going to continue the contract. BUT I think you can leave the office few weeks earlier than the original agreement, company will pay".

To be honest, this list could go on for looooooooooooooong...

Internet makes it easier to create negative value chains. Do you accept this in your workplace?

How much did you earn of negative value chain activities today. When will you pay back? After life?

item.title: EU Unlocking market potential
item.content:encoded:
The European Commission is proposing to unlock market potential for innovative goods and services by lifting obstacles hindering innovation in a first batch of six important markets: eHealth, protective textiles, sustainable construction, recycling, bio-based products and renewable energies. These markets with high economic and societal value represent an annual turnover of more than € 120 billion and 1.9 million jobs in the EU. With this initiative they may increase to over € 300 billion and over 3 million jobs in the EU in 2020.

 

The “Lead Markets Initiative for Europe’ (LMI) proposed by the Commission will foster the emergence of these markets by notably improving legislation, encouraging public procurement and developing interoperable standards (see Memo/08/5). European enterprises would profit from fair and better chances of entering new fast growing world-wide markets with a competitive advantage as lead producers. LMI would also rapidly bring visible advantage for Europe’s consumers in key domains for their welfare.

Update on 2008-01-18 14:25 by Editor in Chief, Lifetime Studios

Press Release 

European Presidency Conference on Innovation and Clusters

22 - 23 January 2008, Clarion Hotel Stockholm

A European Presidency Conference is to be held on 22-23 January 2008 in Stockholm to discuss how to promote innovation in Europe through clusters.

This event is a major milestone for the preparation of the forthcoming Commission Communication on Clusters that will address the question of how to foster stronger clusters in Europe and to better promote cluster cooperation and innovation excellence.

This high-profile event organised under the helm of the Slovenian Presidency of the EU and hosted by the Swedish Government brings together over 300 participants including Commission Vice President Verheugen, a number of ministers and other high-level representatives from the Member States. This conference addresses the role of clusters for innovation and competitiveness in particular by discussing best practice examples of cluster initiatives implemented in different countries. The recently published European Cluster Memorandum and the DG Enterprise and Industry report on Innovation Clusters in Europe have already provided an important input to this discussion. This event is a major milestone for the preparation of the forthcoming Commission Communication on Clusters that will address the question of how to foster stronger clusters in Europe and to better promote cluster cooperation and innovation excellence.For more details please consult the PRO INNO Europe website, where the programme can be found as well as where speeches and presentations will be made available after the conference.
