item.title: Is Mobile TV good for me?
item.content:encoded:
"Mobile TV is television service delivered to subscribers via mobile telecommunications networks, such as the mobile phone carriers. South Korea is at the forefront of this developing sector and BT in the United Kingdom was the first company outside Korea to implement Mobile TV. Wikipedia.org

Have you already tried Mobile TV? According studies, watching movies from your phone or PDA is a personal experience. Unlike you watch TV with your family, mobile TV is usually watched alone. Secondly, the interactive services available to mobile TV makes it unique channel for productions houses. It is very likable, that success stories in the Cable TVs will have new followers better suited for the new platform. Friends will be friends also in mobile, but combining games and interactive TV is truly a new world.

This night I will be in Mobile Second Life and watch episode of Friends there

When SMS messaging were first time added to the phones, the idea was to give consumer an error reporting feature that the phone user would use in communicating to the Mobile Network Operator (MNO). The Consumer reinvented the SMS service and took the service for daily communications.

Similar success story were the music ring tones. When Nokia delivered Säkkijärven polkka to the phone back in 1994 no one expected to see a new industry of musical ring tones to build up. But it did.

The user experience with mobile TV will have it blue oceans for similar developments. New markets, new products.

Lifetime Studios is thinking Mobile TV seriously as a strategic goal for the coming years. Extending the business blog concept to mobile TV is already in the go with some serious blog houses (see f.e. Scobleizer TV).

Lifetime Studios intention is become European Channel Productions house in Mobile TV as well.

From Mobisodes to Webisodes and the secureflash PAY

 

The only thing that hinders future for Lifetime Oy  is raising capital. If you can come up with a game plan how to raise capital for old growth company (not newbie) I am interested.

In Finland, instead of investing now all there is happening is a discussion of tax relief for business angels. Come on , they are needed BUT show me (The Entrepreneur) the money first.

Finding the Business Angels and the Board Team with interest and commitment to invest time and money in mobile productions house is ongoing.  New proposals are welcome.

Digital natives generation is too busy write one-liner. 

Have a nice week ;)

item.title: (LSJ) SanDisk and Big Fish Games Launch Web Site Offering a Library of Casual Games for USB Flash Drives
item.content:encoded:
New Site Offers Four Free Games And 60-Minute Free Trials Of All Titles, Making It Easy To Find Games That Go Anywhere

MILPITAS, CALIFORNIA, March 4, 2008 – SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) and Big Fish Games Inc. today announced a new web site offering a large library of casual games that run on USB flash drives enabled with U3™ smart technology.

The new site (http://www.bigfishgames.com/sandisk) currently offers 56 game titles, and is expected to offer 100 titles by summer. Visitors can download and play games free for one hour. Full versions of the games can be purchased for $19.99, or $6.99 with a Game Club subscription from Big Fish Games. U3 smart technology, developed by SanDisk, allows applications to run from a USB flash drive, without having to be installed on the host computer.

SanDisk and Big Fish Games are also providing four popular games at the site for free: “Atlantis,” an action-puzzle game; “Magic Vines,” a puzzle board game; “Mystery Case Files: Detective Training,” a hidden object game; and “Sudoku,” the number-placement puzzle game. 

SanDisk will add a direct link for the new site to the on-screen U3 Launchpad. The U3 Launchpad with the link will be included on SanDisk Cruzer® Micro flash drives beginning in the second quarter of 2008. When users click this “Games for your drive” link, they will be taken directly to the new site.

“Casual games are a perfect companion for SanDisk’s Cruzer flash drives, because our customers often have a few minutes to play when they’re away from home – in the office, at school, at a friend’s house, or at an Internet café – where it isn’t appropriate or even possible to install a game on the computer itself,” said Ittai Golde, Senior Director of Product Marketing for the USB Division at SanDisk. “By offering a wide selection of Big Fish titles on the new Web site, users of U3 flash drives can discover games that are just right for them.”

“SanDisk’s reputation for innovation in flash storage devices makes them the ideal partner in bringing our games to this platform,” said Paul Handelman, Vice President of Business Development for Big Fish Games. “This partnership gives new and existing Big Fish Games customers the flexibility and convenience of having their game library with them at all times.”

More information on U3 is available at http://www.sandisk.com/U3.

About Big Fish Games

Big Fish Games is a global leader and innovator in the online games industry, producing and delivering the world’s best games and game experiences. Big Fish Games Studios develops and publishes the industry’s leading brands for computers, mobile devices and consoles.
 
Its portfolio of hit games includes Mystery Case Files®, Hidden Expedition™, Azada™ and Fairway Solitaire™. Big Fish Games’ portal at www.bigfishgames.com distributes more games worldwide than any other online site and offers visitors a rapidly expanding selection of content by launching A New Game Every Day!™


About SanDisk

SanDisk Corporation, the inventor and world’s largest supplier of flash storage cards, is a global leader in flash memory – from research, manufacturing and product design to consumer branding and retail distribution. SanDisk’s product portfolio includes flash memory cards for mobile phones, digital cameras and camcorders; digital audio/video players; USB flash drives for consumers and the enterprise; embedded memory for mobile devices; and solid state drives for computers.

SanDisk (http://www.sandisk.com/corporate) is a Silicon Valley-based S&P 500 company, with more than half its sales outside the United States.

item.title: (LSJ) E-Commerce means Lean Management optimized value chains
item.content:encoded:
The European, US, even Global level E-Commerce Business Networks deliver Lean Management's Best Practices Optimized in Action. The focus is in Customer experience.

The costs per Unit (CPU) is optimized with large Buy-Ins and effectively organized Stock and Logistics. The Product Catalog of The Winning Offering is supported by fat-free and virtually created organization structure. The success story is decorated with contracting partners of  International Logistics Supply Chains and On-line Logistical Services.

The Customer Oriented Approach is dominant in the offering with community services including  strong branding with member discounts and Principles of pricing where the daily winning prices are adjusted to the best pitched Google's level.

The Value Chains are optimized with Industrial Engineering Solutions and Supply Chain Management.

Today the Status Quo  of Retail Industry is changing. The commercial power players of The Digital Pocket Corners and Siberian Outposts of Europe (including Finland) find out statistically that European Consumers are rushing to new shopping experiences outside the Locally managed e-Commerce De facto Catering. 

The main reason, other than Entrepreneur's Risk Avoidance Rule of Thumb, why I postponed the Grand Opening of my Virtual Shopping Centre pieniomena(tm) is the fact that Finnish Retail sector has traditionally been rather heavily concentrated. In 2008, The Finnish Retail Industry is divided into two major Camps (Kesko, S-Ryhmä). The two camps have not been very E-Commerce friendly. Selling and buying daily grocery has been a shopping Centre favoured both the Finnish Consumers and the players.

However the experience shops from 2006 have given me the feel that in the consulting I can give advice or two for those that consider opening a electronic shopping centre.

Opening e-Commerce with small Equity

Nearly all Finnish led E-Shops have suffered the higher buy in price which now is rightleously under the gun by the European Consumers. Why pay for the E-middleman if the same Logistics Company brings in the same Branded Goodies wether products are ordered from Helsinki, Münich or Tallinn?

How to Defend e-Commerce Status Quo in mature Markets?

How to defend current e-Commerce Status Quo? The simple answer is

  1. Empower local friendly service.
  2. Create availability of the entertainment value chain in to lifestyle shopping experience. (Ask Lifetime Consulting to help).
  3. Touch of products daily practices (availability).
  4. Daily Revenue Management with prices variying daily
  5. Fair bargain price segments.
  6. OffShore Shops

The Challengers of European Shopping Experience: Hot eshops for Europeans 2008

European level e-Commerce is here.

item.title: (LSJ) Everybody wants to know why I sing the Blues
item.content:encoded:
Ubiquitous. [adj]

  1. (seemingly) present
    everywhere simultaneously.
  2. often encountered
    [Latin ubique everywhere]

Oxford English Dictionary

The very essence of ubiquitous web 3.0 is the flow. Famous Finnish Pianist once said ” istun vain pianon ääreen ja annan musiikin virrata lävitseni” (Olli Mustonen, lainaus muistikuvan perusteella, ei sanasta sanaan).

i.e. “I just sit down and let the music flow through me”. Artist uses his/her intelligence and skills converting the flow to a musical presentation he wants to give. Artist’s whole identity is in that moment. We, listeners, get our own subjective flow from the presentation that combines to our senses, everything we know, intelligence & processing, and other people present at that moment. We feel the music.

What a joy of life ! 

Blues in Espoo means also Ice Hockey Team Blues.

item.title: (LSJ) Interoperability is reality: Microsoft with Finnish Heroes Happen Here Event in Finlandia House including MS Windows 2008 Server
item.content:encoded:
(Lifetime Scope Journal is brought to you from Lifetime Oy Ltd) This morning I ran to Finlandia House to see all new Finnish Heroes Happen Seminar from Microsoft. The launch of MS Windows 2008 Server, MS Visual Studio 2008, and SQL Server 2008 gathered over 1.300 IT people to Finlandia House. As I have stayed out of the IT launches and seminars for over three years mainly because of the studies in Lappeenranta it was nice to meet and see dozens of IT friends and colleagues after this time.

Microsoft and tens of partner companies had made the  necessary arrangements and the day was remarkble well organized. The show started 8am and continued 'till 16pm afterwhich the Party event took over. I missed party this time, but nonetheless show was impressive allright.

In the Lobby I heard one sad news that one of my colleagues from University days was not participating this time. According a friend he died last month. This news somewhat made day more memorable and yes, a little bit sad as well.  I worked with Juhani 1991-1995, and I remember him as loyal friendly person who always dedicated himself to work at hand. Rest in peace ... ...

Back to the show.

Microsoft Windows 2008 Server with SQL Server 2008 seems to product platform worth further studying for outsourced data center platform. For business blogging platform this will need further proof-of-concept study and a decent business cases. Call me if interested about this kind of projects.

[continued]

The most news for me is the change in the openess of the software engineering platform MS Visual Studio 2008. Does this really mean that Open Source Apps can be coexist along with .NET applications?

[continued] 

I gathered many link references which you, dear lifetime friend, can find from the link References above.

"Ohjelmistoyhtiö Microsoft lupaa, että vastakkainasettelun aika avoimen lähdekoodin kannattajien kanssa on ohi. Microsoftin johtajisto ei esimerkiksi enää puhu open source -yhteisöstä kulttina."

 

Vista SP1 ja Windows Server 2008: edut ja hyödyt käytännössä
Windows Server 2008 ja Windows Vista SP1 toimivat saumattomasti yhteen ja tarjoavat aiempaa tehokkaampia mahdollisuuksia tiivimpään integraatioon. Miten tämä integraatio ja tehokkuus näkyy päivittäisissä askareissa?

 

"Microsoft® Silverlight™ is a cross-browser, cross-platform, and cross-device plug-in for delivering the next generation of media experiences and rich interactive applications for the Web. "

item.title: (LSJ) Running Olympics Marathon 2008 Realtime in Second Life
item.content:encoded:
Hello Marathon Runner,

I have a dreamed a possibility to connect the Gym Running Gear in to a virtual running service that is connected and managed from Second life.

Think about logging into Second life and having running experience of Peking Olympics Marathon from Espoo, Finland when the actual race is on?

 
To achieve this technically things seem to be pretty straightforward.

1. Add a Second life capable shoe measuring device to your ASICS Kayano shoes to measure your speed and whereabouts.

2. Wear f.e. Nike wearable transmitter with Suunto Running Computer to measure personal Data.

3. Use interactive connection to Running Mat to ensure up and downhills are timely right. Make the fan act according the weather conditions.

4. Add 3d gear to really feel real-time running with drink kand toilet pauses online. Send the data realtime with 3G to Second Life. Watch yourself on a Screen with Second Life including competition track and surroundings. Add stunning recorded sounds of cheering audience!

Certainly someone people needs to be running in Peking with cameras installed to give the sights and sounds of the actual route. How about from 2.04 up to 5.04 with runtime classes 15 minutes?

 

My challenge to Peking Olympics: Arrange possibility to join the games through virtuality services like Second Life. Why should I sit and watch the Marathon from TV if I can run it in my Gym? Great Exercise.

The data, the gear, everything is ready to this wish become true! 

 

 

 

 

 

So dear lifetime friend,

What is your virtual dream?

Share it with other readers, be happy.

 

Running with Blogtheristo

item.content:encoded:
Prime Minister of Finland is responsible of the image we Finns have abroad. His maneuvers with the ex-girlfriend and their SMS Sex messages communications media show has reached yet another stage when the messages were published in Swedish Internet pages.

The amount of bad-will levels-off such highs that here in LSJ I wonder why he is still in the job?

I have known Mr. Vanhanen from his public image since 2002 or so. When he started his image was "perfect": Married, no alcohol, Against EU and Nuclear Power: He had supporters and he supported people and ideas from left to right - social democrats to kokoomus. His character were stiff, but slowly his media appeal turned Finns on. He became celebrity of Finland with intensive media sponsoring and good-fellow network. He divorced and the hell skies opened.

The first Government Mr. Matti Vanhanen led did what it promised starting off from a difficult situation of previous Prime Minister Jäätteenmäki. This can be seen as one of his legacy from the first Government.

Finns are loyal. Even when the sex scandal were out as published book 2007, the public opinion seemed to favour of him as he announced "What are the limits of Privacy of Prime Minister. Can't I have any personal life?"

The Emperor's new clothers are not the privacy Mr. Vanhanen is seeking. The best way to have privacy is  talk the talk honestly. And then walk the same walk. In politics, lying is really master art when it comes to personal relationship. People want to know who you are dating. As simple as that. No exceptions in the PM level, I hear you saying. If he decides to go back to Editor of Kehäsanomat I bet his dating will not be in interest of international audiences. But, as today, the Finland's PM's ladies are front page news.

 

Many in Finland  think that supporting oneself personal privacy and personal communications is essential to western way-of-life and thinking. In general, Mr. Vanhanen conclusions as such are good and recommendable. But, this is not the point.

The Point is Mr. Matti Vanhanen, that you have lied for years to Finnish audience about yourself. Your image in the Media mismatch the reality. And reality usually wins.

"You told you were high class, but that was just another lie" like king of Rock and Roll announce in a lyrics that might semantically be linked to the case. And lying is not far away from betrayal. As a consumer I feel that the 'PM product' I hoped and believed 2002-2007 to get is not the one I really have got 2002-2008. I am honestly disappointed about his character back those years.

And here is the real question. Is there any ethical minutes in the doings of Prime Minister Vanhanen in 2002-2007? Trusting third parties say he has been always trustworthy. Does his own behaviour shadow his trustworthiness?

Does this SMS sex scandal show to the public, that the man behind the mask is somewhat different?

Do we care? Most Finns do (as this is common procedures).

So here comes my personal conclusion: Mr. Matti Vanhanen please resign since you have broken the trust I had with you. Show that you talk the talk, and walk the walk. Thank  You. and goodbye from my TV.

OR

make clear case of changing the overall apperance in the front of the public eye. Emperor's new clothes do not suit you.

The Game plan for PM and other Parliament Members of Finland for 2008 and the years of the second term still to go:

1. Be honest to those voted you,

2. Stop fooling around with your Communications. Especially the SMS messaging is doing much of the damage.

3. Don't buy Emperor's new clothes. People know you too well.

LSJ will follow the case, stay tuned.

 

Thank you for being a lifetime friend.

blogtheristo

item.title: (LSJ) Länsiväyläjouksu 2008
item.content:encoded:
Today I opened among quite many runner this years competition season. As usual, the weather and clothing played a key role once again. The route starts from Otaniemi just few blogs from Nokia HQ and Univ. of Technology (TKK), and the heads to Tapiola, one of the four centers in Espoo. The tricky part is when the route goes from Espoo to Helsinki and back. There is seaside and there is rather long bridges. When clothing is right for the bridges you have damn too much for ther rest of the 17,4 km route.

This year I chose to take minimum clothing. The temperature was expected to be 17 degrees Celsius, and yes, again rough wind came in without a warning. However, to my surprise, run went well and I did not freeze anywhere after 14 kms.

My leg injury is now history, but 5 weeks of light training had made my speed a decrease 10%. Fortunately I found my speed after 13 kms, I could speed up 'till Finish line all the way.

1.24.10 is good performance for today condition especially that again was starting too back row witch took 1-2 minutes out of the real effort.

I have some hopes that 10th of May and Helsinki City Run I will in back my schedule of Running.

In any case today I won myself and overall performance is 9/10.

My new Ipod worked like a dream. Really, Really thank you Apple for this device!

I have never had a MP player as GOOD as the Ipod is !

 

See you in HCR 10th of May .. Have a nice 1st of May Party (if there something like it where you live)..

The Climate Change can be changed.

item.title: (LSJ) Taking Care of Corporate Digital Brand and IPRs
item.content:encoded:
Today I read about MelbourneIT acquiring the VeriSign DBMS business for m$ 50. MelbourneIT is Australian public company which produces high quality DNS name services and hosting. Adding extended digital Brand management services from Verisign Corp. makes MelbourneITs offering much stronger.And the real benefit comes to any SMEs struggling with the phishing sites and copycat trademarks. LSJ is supporting stronger corporate identities and all measures that prevent phishing sites to succeed. Writing your own business blog is an art form. And we should protect such activities and SMEs,IMHO.

*****BOC

Sometimes even larger corporations unintentionally turn phishing as their marketing strategy. Many occasions this happens when the strategy of the corporation is now clear enough for the marketing department. The Marketing Office then translates the blurry directives of marketing department to a series of ads and online marketing efforts that actually harms the corporation's big picture.

It is the responsibility of the Management to tell their Marketing with clear voice what is the real strategy, and how to get there. With this clear picture in mind all marketing efforts have be planned and put in to productions.

Otherwise, loosing local customers with bad dealings their IPRs, relations with a Phishing scenarios and misusing their customers intellectual property is the outcome.

The Marketing Depths Ride with the devil is not good for the loyal Customers of the Corporation. In the end, it is even more damaging for the paying Corporation.

This kind of Phishing Marketing is not acceptable by the MNCs Management, not even if that leads to a great party and Narcissistic Victories in the marketing department and their partners.
*****EOC
Dear Entrepreneur, taking care of your Immaterial Rights including ideas, innovations, domain addresses and trademarks is becoming more important than ever. If your domain hosting offer extended IPR services in effort to prevent of copycats marketeers and phishing siters to violate your business, I think this offer should be considered in your company board carefully.

Thank you for being a lifetime friend,

item.title: (LSJ) Why it is so tough to become successful Growth Entrepreneur?
item.content:encoded:
I started Lifetime Oy 1989. I have failed twice for entering markets with my business plan, namely 1992 and 1997. I have got some loans 1996 to start-up, and walked through the new positioning of Entrepreneur in the Finnish Society.

In the 80’s Entrepreneurs were considered as 1) Crooks and Criminals 2) Crazy Risk takers who risked everything for their business.If things went bad hanging yourself to the tree after loosing everything was the de facto honourable way of closing business! The System administration similar to Soviet Union was the way to do things in the 80s.

In the 90’s new funding  instruments emerged and Government of Finland introduced ‘women loans’ - money loans guaranteed by State for small business emerged to lighten start-up burden. These loans were something like 10-50 t€ and the real meaning were to help Hair Saloons  and other work oriented Entrepreneurs to succeed the start. No one discussed nor offered any Business Angel money. Venture Capital was not available to SMEs. The loan was ofcourse quite too small for anything else than the barber chair with a room. But nonethless it was change of mindset!

 

2005 I started to study Entrepreneurship in the Lappeenranta University of Tech. The Innovations and VCs become familiar and I raised high hopes to finding such a business plan that would be backed up by VCs. Writing Business plans and opening up this site were the first things I learned again.  Google Adsense were hot in the news for making money. I hope your site has brought you fortunes. Mine has too ;-)

What I have learned in four years? Why it is so hard to become successful Growth Entrepreneur? 

 

My definition of Growth Entrepreneurship goes like this:

Growth Entrepreneurship consists of 2 simultaneous processes:

1. Learning as an Entrepreneur and Man. 

2. and Developing business ideas in to success stories and profitable Innovations.

At the same time you have to win daily your struggle of staying alive and finding money to support your family activities.

* The ability to execute Entrepreneur lifestyle IS already sign of commitment. 

* The ability to run business daily routines IS already sign solid business skills.

 

Web 2.0 world is fascinating. New startups come to publicity daily. What strikes me is that all of the are published from Silicon Valley Area / USA. No European software services is happening, not at least in the same quantities.

The discussion of Financial issues in Finland is still Government Aid Oriented. The Entrepreneur as person is not really considered that important. They sitill miss next Nokia.  Invent some pocket calculator, invent device. Then youre doing real innnovations, I hear them thinking. This is also changing but was the mantra for a decade.

Well, Charlie Chaplin, who is my favourite of running his studios quite successfully with countless productions also ran successful business as well. He was backed up VCs that acknowledged his talent to setup the Chaplin Studios. No Goverment Systems there (1920s).

 

Why we, 2008, ( in the EU, Finland, or Globally) are not concentrating on finding and helping new talents that really are innovators or have some other important role in the Innovation value chain? The challenges, f.e. sustainable future, are too important to waste time on secondary pyramidio investment ‘systems’. Only one that miss this game is the third party charging of the ‘planning’.

Writing NIY support forms (30pp) to get something financial help out is now in my agenda. Help! I contacted three business consultants here in Espoo, but none of the understood much of the Forms business. Who does?

Put people in charge and you find the taking the responsibility.

“Take in coach I’m ready to play..today” 

John Fogerty (Rock on John already 40 years and still going strong!!!) 

[continued]

item.title: (LSJ) Generation Y takes your business further !
item.content:encoded:
Generation Y is Here

 

Those of us who belong to Generation Y are born in the late 1970’s and early 1980’s.

Generation Y is described in Media as generation with great semantic knowledge, and especially increased team play.

They are passionate for great digital success stories. According Media, among Yers there are no leadership ambitions.

Generation Y is not a fad. It is not a media ploy either. It means  the real players for the time being. Running Mercedes already at their twenties they are the best equipped generation ever. Ride on, dear Y. You have Director’s chair waiting here in Lifetime Studios. Contact today, and we can build things together.

 

In Universitities generation Y is innovation oriented. And thinking world’s problems, they might just be saving the World as well. At least I am putting my hope for these people. Really.

 

In their recent book, Reynol Junco and Jeanna Mastrodicasa (2007) [21] found that in a survey of 7,705 college students in the US:

  • 97% own a computer
  • 94% own a cell phone
  • 76% use Instant Messaging.
  • 15% of IM users are logged on 24 hours a day/7 days a week
  • 34% use websites as their primary source of news
  • 28% author a blog and 44% read blogs
  • 49% download music using peer-to-peer file sharing
  • 75% of college students have a Facebook account [22]
  • 60% own some type of portable music and/or video device such as an iPod. (read more from Wikipedia/references).

Today I finally went to see Claude Monet x 12. How it went?  Well, there were only 12 original paintings from Claude Monet, but those were enough to get the feeling of his painting style and why it become the inspiration for generations to come. The Finnish Impressionists followed Monet’s work almost simultaneously and they copied everything they could from Monet Art Party (as one of the Finns called Impressionism - Art Party). Many Finnish painters lived and live in Paris those days and bridges, women with umbrellas, and water lilies are shown in their work like of those of Monet’s

 

French painter is much loved all over the world. Impressionism has inspired lot of artist’s perspirations. There is generations who have followed the original Impressionists, among them is the inventor Claude Monet himself.

stop back tomorrow for more Monet story.

The Results based on market research in which 2.950 executives where interviewed. 

The fastest climber up the chart were from car industry. Indian car manufacturer Tata corp. reached sixth position.

Nokia Corporation was at the tenth position.

From Game industry the best climber was Nintendo Corporation.

"Toyota Motor Corp., which leapt 10 spots this year to No. 4, is becoming a master of many as well.  The Japanese auto giant is best known for an obsessive focus on innovating its manufacturing processes. But thanks to the hot-selling Prius, Toyota is earning even more respect as a product innovator. It is also collaborating more closely with suppliers to generate innovation. Rather than work with suppliers just to cut costs of individual parts, it is delving further back in the design process to find savings spanning entire vehicle systems." from the Business Week Article.

item.title: (LSJ) Windows XP sp3 finnish finished finally from finn no f words just fine
item.content:encoded:
Over the last week I have been updating productions platforms here in Lifetime Studios, Espoo. I decided to look again to Linux. Last time I had active servers running Linux were 2000 with Red Hat Linux Server software. We setup an ordinary PC to carry Ubuntu 8.0.4 Linux distribution, and it seems that 8 years have make things little easier with setting up a Linux Platform.

The Second big thing in the operating system area is the Windows XP Service Pack 3 that is currently available also in Finnish (That is the opening line joke).

Upgrading all Studios XP's went through smoothly and if I compare my XP Platform and Ubuntu this is not very fair, but somehow Linux is still one step behind.

To make all the web 2.0 applications and stuff like passwords manager to run smoothly in Ubuntu means months of work for me. I think that for Social Networking, Sales, Business Bloggin' my choice will be for the practical reasons Windows XP. The only platform I am seriously considering to replace this is - yes - Windows Vista.

 

For Productions platform in the open source programming and server management Ubuntu 8.0.4 will have its advantage.

It is stable production platform for sure, and secure as well.

 

So this is a game of win-win - Windows - Linux for the Lifetime Studios. I hope this is fine with you as well.

 

Thank you for being a lifetime friend,

I will start planning my summer holidays starting somewhere in July. I am planning to keep luxurious 3-4 weeks summer holidays with my family and travelling..

Risto

item.title: Software Engineering Strategy for Lifetime Oy Ltd.
item.content:encoded:
Lifetime Studios Introduction Summer 2008 

 

Since opening my first blogs  and podcast 2005 there have been a lot going on in the web 2.0 world. Now that I have been discussing with Software Engineering houses about partnership insights and co-operation possibilities I realized that I need to update my Software Engineering Strategy for Lifetime Oy Ltd.

The Business blog Building Digital Assets (BDA) from Lifetime Studios is about the new Enterprise 2.0 Platform and my small steps to learn all the needed skills.  

The Business blog Flow is the Pay (FP) from Lifetime Studios is about the Digital Productions World that comes with Enterprise 2.0 Platform.

I hope you would write Feedback about your new products, development and project experiences and Academic Proceedings in these blogs. The feedback is monitored but you can leave your comments with or without ID.

Lifetime Friends Community will be a place to meet other Lifetime Studios friends, gather resources and share a smile. 

In Twine I have opened few Semantic Web learning Twines, Mobile Commerce Strategies include links and insights about the new consumer platforms and the Strategic Approach including Business Models etc. For Programming Geeks there is Ruby on Rails Advanced Twine which will hold track on developments in the Enterprise Tools Area.

And don’t forget Impressionism, the twine about Art and Wine. Now, after this complimentary introduction about Lifetime Studios current online efforts let’s get back to the Software Engineering Strategy, over to you Risto (Contact me if you would like to write / publish entry about your company news to LSJ).

 

Traditional Software Engineering Strategy 1.0

 

 

“The application of a systematic, disciplined, quantifiable approach to the development, operation, and maintenance of software.” [IEEE 610.12]

“Establishment and use of sound Engineering principles in order to obtain economically software that is reliable and works efficiently on real machines” [Naur and Randell, 1969]

“For all Customer Projects, stability, flexibility and open database connectivity are essential to productivity and profitability. CodeGear’s stable, proven development environments help developers to improve software quality, reduce software defects and complete projects faster. Whether you’re building applications for standalone desktop, client/server workgroups, or multi-tiered enterprise - choosing the right development tools is crucial to project success.” [Codegear Ad,June 2008]

I programmed first time 1984 with Commodore 64 and Simon’s basic. From those early coding days I have been involved with tens of software engineering projects. In the early MS Windows days the Borland (Today CodeGear) tools were among the most used, namely Borland Pascal 3.0 and Borland C 1.5 and 2.0. I really liked to write code those days, so getting back to the code level is really exciting. I have promised not to take any crappy administrative projects that would brake my learning process.

1991 I graduated from Espoo-Vantaa, and that summer I wrote somewhat first text in Finnish about Object- Oriented Programming as a process (Olio-ohjelmointi,1991, Suomen atk-kustannus). This text was full of error translations (no one had made translations earlier anywhere) and mistakes (and yes misunderstanding), but the meta-data level of the Software Engineering as a process were somewhat semantically correct at the time. There were English compilation that used somewhat similar approach until 1999 widely used in Universities.

Later on, a book called Ohjelmistotuotanto by professor Ilkka Haikala and Director Jukka Märijärvi from Nokia Software Division were published as late as 1995 that included much needed update and corrected the whole process.

I found the eight edition of Ohjelmistotuotanto from public library. The book offer all-round view of the discipline of Software Engineering 1.0. Book is widely used in Academic courses in various Universities in Finland.

 

When we think world of Semantic enabled Architecture, Social Media 2.0, Mobile User Platform, and all new business models it is more than clear that the old fashioned relational database connected to front-end programming paradigm needs to be revisioned and expanded. Three layer model is a good start with SOA  and EAI. Using Web Services bring more asyncronous possibilities and outsourcing of services.

But this is only the beginning. Enterprise 2.0 Software Engineering Strategy is changing rapidly. LSJ will follow the situation.

Trends Gallery

* mobile Internet is winning the game with Iphone and Smart Phones.

* Nokia Ovi brand is open source based.

* Semantic Web Solutions will be embedded to ICT Application Architecture.

* Artificial Intelligence is finally reality in consumer products?

* Object-Oriented Databases , full-text databases finally step up to extend relational databases approach.

* new Consumer APIs

* New Business Models

 

 

 

[continued]

item.title: (LSJ) The Momentum Effect: How to Ignite Exceptional Growth by J.C. Larreche
item.content:encoded:
Exceptional growth seems to be a must have for some people here in Finland. There is Dream of next major global company to pop-up somewhere from the Finnish woods.

For many, this is not a day dream but it is convenient way of charging consulting fees from various Government aided and funded organisations and the so called new company pyramid helping hands. Some of the organizations are themselves public companies and they possess and use considerable power over the SME network. Some include clever people who have filled their function as chiefs of various helping iniatives. Without mentioning the EU level. To me, all hands-in-their-pockets this is OK.

If thousands of people get their living of thinking ways how to organize and lead the innovative human efforts to find scarce public finance. Sometimes it is enough to give a statement that there seems to be problems in Innovations System to get paid ;-).

To Entrepreneur or Artist herself / himself, to participate to ongoing battle of helping hands this is mostly waste of time.

Working months to add one line to Governmental program want-to-do-some-day section is far away from getting any funding to Lifetime Studios next productions business plan.

My advice here is to put funding focus totally to innovator people (de facto), not the companies (de jure).

Nor does the connections found from the grey area consultants give much of advice how to proceed. As always best knowledge is learned through hard work, not by committee meetings.

As an Entrepreneur Summary: It is OK to keep Innovations Framework as rewarding as possible to really harvest the best innovations and turn them in to global business success stories.

However, this is a task that should be done by helping organizations.

For the Entrepreneur to-do list is more like the following:

1. Create the Pitch that holds promise of how to Ignite Exceptional Growth.

Finding the Momemtum is essential.

2.When funding offers start to pour in to your company:

Check out the Terms sheet wether some if any of the raised money really enter your pockets in the Exit from your Innovationas.

Keep IPRs and trademarks tightly to yourself.Protect your Intellectual Capital as well.

3.Concentrate to learn and become Best-of-Class in your Industry.

Best Pitch is when you can operate with your own funding.

I am the Boss of this company.

Sounds good, doesn’t it?

item.title: The I want Quick Wins Dilemma: Stop Saving Start Changing
item.content:encoded: The “Quick Wins Only” Scenario As I was working as an Industrial Project Manager times (budget that is) went rough in the 2001-2002. Yearly budget were cut down and Telco project portfolio were fixed to “Quick Wins Only” mode. To reduce ongoing projects was the only way forward. The goal at the time were to find projects which had short payback time or ROI and high business value. Today, many businesses are again looking for Quick Wins Only mode with their web 2.0 strategy. The ICT project portfolios is scaled down, systems and people are outsourced. The ” We are here to Save Money Only” Scenario The consolidated international ICT MNC’s corporations have best offers to do just that. Scaling down services, shutting down services teams is easy. All things great I hear Consultant replacing CIO & team whispering ? The “Change we believe in” Scenario At the same time, many of the end-Customers and your partnering value chain companies are moving rapidly to use of new Web 2.0 applications Paradigm as their main IT strategy. And The Winners Prize goes to.. The growth figures of user accounts and traffic for the social networking / web 2.0 services is rapid. As always some services do better than others. Facebook reaching MySpace in Traffic etc. shows that web 2.0 world is evolving. The “I am here feeling OK” Scenario F.e. in the Twitter there are already many of us that keep up their activity streams up to the minute and organize our working life using these new tools and Paradigm Only. The Paradigm Shift with years of learning curve Twitter / Myspace / Twine based learning, communities, personal relations, public relations, and finally consumerism in its all forms IS the way of doing business for us.There is no quick wins but Paradigm Shift with years of learning curve. The Internet 1.0 relief The Internet 1.0 home pages is not what your potential customers want. They want your presence. To solve their project questions, help with that report, write that business plan, rewrite that code. Be part of that new product launch, have a lunch with discussions of future of web, participate in virtual seminar, etc. Really every business aspect has its own web 2.0 service somewhere in the websphere. We need your web page as sign of trustful company. We want to give Feedback securely. We need your business blogging to understand your company strategy, ongoing projects, Partner offerings, and other news information. When will your company start to focus again to customers, not enterprise resource planning, or outsourcing? Building new teams from the people that are already in the Digital Natives level living with Presence Information is the challenge. Are your company in or out? Presence Information is important. You need to know whereabouts of your customers, friends, competitors etc. How this can be reached without learning to walk first? Secondly the need of transforming business strategies, business models, value networks etc. With Web 2.0 and Semantic Web thing is like with any major ICT Infra Area upgrade. You and your people need to learn the new Paradigm of Thinking first. Then there is considerable Testing Period. What are the actual customers needs and how to address them? Semantic Web, but also Business Blogging is now at the Testing Period Phase for Lifetime Oy Ltd. From 2005 on I have been studying Social Networking, Business Blogging, and How to create semantic network through tools like Technorati, del.icio.us and Digg. Today I think some things start to go semantically to their right places. The Offering of Lifetime Oy Ltd. is clarifying every day. Thank you for being active friend. E-Commerce is important part of Social Networking. Every connection is a marketing relation and may lead in to possible Sales increase in the future. From the database update to the Status line update. Many times I meet Finnish Managers who have found me delivering quick win projects for them in previous years. They ask ” Can you explain how Lifetime Oy Ltd. could make things better? I don’t understand how to glue this to what we have at the office today.” The problem is how to help customers to leap over the learning curve and show profitable bottom line to invest R &D and projects money to Web 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5 projects. The uggly version is: ” Change or Die ” (Or retire) The nice version: ” Your Customers are already in the Twitter and Myspace. Where is your business?” The Truthful version: ” Entering web 2.0 services business platform needs lot of hard work. Prepare to invest money to stay in the picture in coming years”

wp:comment.wp:comment_content:
(Adapted from www.semanticwebjournal.org)

Semantic Web technologies were initially designed before the rise of the Web 2.0 methods for large-scale socially-contributed content.

1. What lessons should Semantic Web technologies draw from the popularity of tag systems, social networks, mashups, and other Web 2.0 techniques?

2- Does the success of the social, user-oriented contribution models of Web 2.0 impact the way that Semantic Web data should be created, deployed, exploited, managed, and shared? In short, should particular aspects of the Semantic Web be reconsidered in the light of Web 2.0?

For example:

How can we exploit the wisdom of crowds to extend and maintain ontologies and instance information? Could social software provide the missing mechanisms for sharing ontologies and metadata? Are there implications for existing family of web ontology languages?

Is the existing work on Semantic Web Services adequate to support the Web 2.0 world's practice of creating mashups?

The focus of Service Web 3.0 will be to:

Create, maintain, and publish roadmaps as a means to plan and coordinate framework and community activities for a future service world

Set-up of dedicated service clusters focusing on Semantic Web services within STI2 network (Semantic Technology Institute International)

Provide information material as white papers and feasibility studies for raising the awareness for the technology in industry, introducing new business models and systematically facilitating Semantic Web services and Semantic Web technology adoption, in particular for SMEs

Support standardization activities for semantic service descriptions

Create a European International Position Strategy for collaboration with key IT companies and coordination of strategies with regard to framework activities.

Exploit synergies through networking and cross-fertilization with other research and network projects related to this area

Organize special focused conferences and seminars

Service Web 3.0 will pave the way to realize a world where billions of parties are exposing and consuming services via advanced Web technology.

(LSJ, Editor in Chief)

Hello,

How has your running been this summer? I have trained from starting January systematically for 33 weeks now and it is time to start toning and closing this year marathon season. For me, the fall is season for cykling and weight lifting. Exercising multiple sports is important to keep your body in agile All-Round Shape.

There is still one marathon this summer, Helsinki CIty Marathon 2008. Helsinki City Marathon is the second largest marathon event in Scandinavia. Over 6,400 runners from 39 nationalities participated in Helsinki in 2007. With additional running events there were as many as 7,100 runners. The finish line is at the Helsinki Olympic Stadium.

For my running races 2008, the closing will be in the Pääkaupunkiseutujuoksu (10,1km  one quater marathon). I consider running also the Espoo Rantamarathon booking in the Juoksija.fi if I get green light from my Physiotherapics.

Check out all new Asics shoes from Updated Marathon Manager 2.0

The Asics Nimbus 10tm product line is now included, both for men and for women.

Happy Running



One tip: Use Ice daily to avoid leg insuries. Ten minutes of ice every morning and evening will prevent many muscular problems when running exceed 80km a week. Not to mention good stretching and the best equipment either..

Thank you for being a lifetime friend,

Risto

item.title: (LSJ) Helping elderly people for 7 weeks
item.content:encoded:
(LSJ) This summer was special to me. I was a driver of minivan serving elderly people in Munkkivuori, Haaga, Kaskisaari, and some other districts of Helsinki. To me, being old has been something rather far away of a thingy, and since my parents are not yet that old timers yet, especially the lifestyle of elderly people were not that familiar.

To my suprise, the best of the people at their eighties and nineties were in good shape, warm, and always full of fun and ‘tweeting’ jokes. I really enjoyed many trips with them!

The services Community Centers, like Riistakallio, Kannelkoti, Haagan Palvelutalo, kept elderly people in a community that lived their own world peacefully. Weekly, a Bus made as Mobile Shopping Mall visited and served those who could not climb to my minibus and head to the local Mall. I drove 50 to 100 grandmothers and grandfathers to shop and back daily.

I think this is my Ultimate Mobile Office experience so far.

How was your Summer?

item.title: (LSJ) How can Semantic Web and Web 2.0 drive company to grow?
item.content:encoded:
The following text is the first blog entry for Lifetime Scope Journal (LSJ) by Mr. Oskari Uotinen.

Semantic Web Connections

If you want to share our readers a story, product review, opinion, or any other digital asset, please  contact us. 

Br. Risto Päärni,

Editor in Chief,

Lifetime Scope Journal (LSJ)

Thank you of being a lifetime friend! Lifetime Scope Journal @LSJ2030 at your service!

 

  

The Learning Organization

Learning organizations have continued to remain in the centre of management studies since 90’s. The dynamics of operational environment require organizations to pay all the time growing attention to maintaining their competitive advantage. Global competition, differing customer needs and technical development all make it harder for the companies to keep going in the phase.

The Semantic Web Promise

How can Semantic Web and Web 2.0 then assist companies in maintaining their status – and even to grow? There are numerous examples of companies succeeded in for example engaging customers with the help of Web 2.0 services. This is not, however, even near the whole spectrum of possibilities that Web 2.0 offers for companies in data management, training, product development and so on.

 

It is not enough for the companies to establish a fan page in Facebook. It is of course a good start Pictures Copyright Kalle Päärni Productions 2010.but, according to Sirkka Järvenpää from Texas University (link to: http://www.gemilo.com/yritysblogi/sosiaalisen-median-trendeja-tyomaailmasta/), the whole process behind Web 2.0 should be planned and implemented well. Usage of Web 2.0 tools and services should, of course, be aligned with corporate strategy and not to be built as a separate part, neither.

Why I mentioned learning organizations in the first chapter?

This is because learning and adoption of new ways to work are needed in order to grasp the idea and possibilities that Web 2.0 offers for companies. On the other hand Web 2.0 can serve as a great catalyst for learning.

To take an example, Wikis can ease flow of information, function as a place where employees can share their ideas and thoughts that company can then take advantage of. And this all can lead to increased employee engagement and thus greater productivity. 

 

About the Author

Mr. Uotinen is a consultant and a trainer in the field of educational administration. He is acquainted with thematic of learning organizations and Web 2.0, especially how Web 2.0 can be used with a view to knowledge management and education.

You can reach Mr. Uotinen at twitter @OskariUotinen

Update on 2010-01-30 02:57 by Editor in Chief, Lifetime Studios

Editor’s Note: We publish this draft to help and to courage new writer talents to explore the possibilities of blog writing. Thank you of being a lifetime friend !

<H3>How to implement Web 2.0?</H3>


In the previous entry I made a notion that adoption of new ways to work is needed in order to exploit Web 2.0 services. Implementing Web 2.0 in any company means shifting from traditional top-down design to more collaborative ways of working and thinking, a shift that many companies have already seen to be fundamental for their success. By this I mean that in order for companies to survive in the postmodern business world they need to take a step forward to more open communication towards their customers and employees. Web 2.0 cannot be, however, considered to be an easy step to take.

Web 2.0 brings both, customers and employees, closer to the point where decisions are made and goods are produced. It makes the company more transparent. 

Global competition has made it extremely difficult to gain competitive advantage. Nowadays most of the customers find information about products and services in the Internet. Your company may have Internet site and may be found in Google, but so do millions of companies worldwide. Every company has to think how they can be differentiated from all the others.

As you represent your company in the social networks of the Internet your professional identity cannot be separated from your private and personal ones. This can be, however, considered to be an advantage. It brings humanity to the organization as an entity. 

By participating in the everyday practices of the organization and in the creation of perceived social reality, managers could bring themselves closer to the everyday level of the company, and thus encourage employees to share new ideas. No-one else could be able to enhance the everyday processes better than the ones who are involved in them.

Don’t you have time? Don’t you see the advantages? Social media expert, communications consultant Christina Forsgård has summed up that all the same arguments were heard already as e-mail was a novel phenomena: I don’t have time for this, this all is a complete waste of time… After all, the advantages of e-mail cannot be denied.

ONE-LINER(Comment from Someone): Can Web 2.0 be a source of competitive advantage?

item.title: (LSJ) Should Cloud Computing Be On Your Roadmap?
item.content:encoded:
See Executive Suite Discussion at LinkedIn.com

My reply today is as follows:

Without doubt, Cloud Computing is a key element for SME’s path from idea to Innovation in the field of Web 2 Services. Cloud Computing creates possibility to create Early Demos for financial rounds, and prepares Agile Software Engineering Methods as well.

The availability and offering is not yet fully consolidated, and more Cloud Computing and SaaS positioning is needed in the markets (as I see it)

More broadly, in the traditional ICT, SaaS delivered through global Cloud Computing Services will can give advantage for Costs Reductions and raised usability.

The Pitfalls are related to security, maintenance, contract Management f.e. For a larger corporation the Complexity of ICT Services reduces the usability of Cloud Computing.

Yes, Cloud Computing is a key element for ICT’s Project Portfolio of 2010.

Update on 2010-02-06 15:37 by Editor in Chief, Lifetime Studios

The Future of Cloud Computing
26 January 2010

item.title: (LSJ) Löydä perille: Sosiaalisen median verkkokartta prosessina
item.content:encoded:
31.10.2010 8:33, Risto Päärni, toimitusjohtaja, Lifetime Oy

Ohessa vastaukseni Yrittäjät.fi sivulle kuinka yrityksen tulee hyödyntää sosiaalisen median verkkokarttaa.
Luonnollisesti yrityksen toimiala, tuotteet, markkinontimix 7P vaikuttaa prosessiin.
Sosiaalisen median verkkokartta prosessina:
1. Projektoi hankkeet.
2. Teetä yrityksen kotisivut kuntoon
3. Teetä Facebook näkyvyys tuotteille ja yritykselle kuntoon luomalla tuotesivut ja tuotteille FB-kampanjat.
4. Hyödynnä muita social media kanavia yrityksenne markkinointistrategian mukaisesti, kuitenkin riittävän laaja-alaisesti.
5. Hyödynnä verkkokaupankäyntimahdollisuudet, teetä verkkokauppa.
6. Hanki palautetta, mittaa, kouluta henkilökuntaa, ja aloita alusta 1-3 krt. vuodessa.

item.title: (LSJ) How did I lost my touch for writing and running?
item.content:encoded:
(LSJ) Two years after I lost my touch for writing I have been slowly awakening from the workaholism I have been in . After finalising my M.Sc (2007) in Lappeenranta University of Technology everything should have been in upper-right position. But, the markets plummeted in October 2007. The concequenses for me were serious. Firstly, I could not get a job from Industrial Management field since all positions was closed in Finland 2007-2008 (Paper industry, f.e.). Secondly, my stock portfolio suddenly lost 65 % of its value. To sell anything from my portfolio was not an option. Thirdly, web 2.0 was not yet selling to the masses. Twitter was a promising platform, nothing else, and Facebook either weren t that interesting at the time. MySpace was a marginal stuff here in Finland. Google Adwords did work, but I did want to end-up with selling ads.
Luckily, or so I thought at the time, I managed to get a second job, driving a minivan.
The Driver
After driver s license for a truck, and then second grade for a 88 seats bus, I could be accepted as bus driver 2008.
The pros of driving minivan, or mobile consulting as I call it, is that the customer base is somewhat endless . Travelling stays no matter what markets say. Back in 2008 I remember waiting for a customer with my Nokia N73 reading emails and trying to stay in the picture with all the news technology and other issues I was following. This turned out to be an lost battle. Writing anything with a phone was not possible, neither to think any larger managerial issues while serving on the road.
(Today, I have IPhone, and with Squarespace IPhone App there is possibility to blog on the road. Wait my first postings to finalize).
Day and Night
I was working day and night to ensure that lifetime Studios would have a second chance after the turn expected would come in and save my portfolio. My plans to move to San Francisco were just about to realize when the economy over there went down. I decided to keep on driving, and wait for the next up-turn here and there.
The night shifts (two per week) had their toll. As of age of 44, my memory started to faint occasionally. Writing anything after night shift is, well impossible. Luckily for me I kept running although my marathon results started to sink from 3.30 toward 4.30 and beyond. Sitting in a car is hardly a good way to keep fit, not mentioning the truck driver s menu available with the coffee shops and McDonald s Drive-Inns. I gained some weight, which now is slowly going down.
The Cross-Roads
It took me nearly 2 years to find any new customers for Lifetime Studios. This gave me the opportunity to bias my workload even more and start writing and doing things I love the most. The best part of driving is that you deal with real people. I do like that. For an engineer, this has been real social skills school. To listen more, and not to argue. I have learned a tons of good advices in these years for people management too. Sometimes, i have felt that I have been accepted as a driver, and felt secretly some pride about it. Really nice for a old geek like me.
Back to Lifetime Studios
Today I am focused with programming again. I love to write code. Blogging is still the best thing in web for me. I don t work at nightshifts. This gives me clarity to think. I run everyday, and the goal for me is 6th of March Marato de Barcelona. I even decided to lauch Marathon School here in Espoo. It is not yet clear wether it will go. But for me that is not the main issue. I will be running there anyhow.
I think I am a bad sales person. But, I have never given up for being an Entrepreneur, as this is my twenty second year of being owner of Lifetime Oy Ltd. It has never really payed me off, but I feel great satisfaction of the ideas and businesses that I have been innovating and motivating over the years. Maybe yours too? I could mention few big names (maybe in my book).
My advice to young entrepreneur would be: Never give up, give yourself time, and maybe your startup make big. I am big fan of your idea . Don t expect to see miracles, in weeks, or even years. Unless you are in SF ;-)

Next steps
I would need 1-3 new customers that would need 20-30 hours totally per week to step-up to next level with Lifetime Studios. This sounds like a modest step, but in the Finnish business climate, sometimes this seems even too tough to cope with. The sky is a bit lower than it used to be ;-)
The Guilty Feeling
Many new Social Media advisers, business owners etc. have started their business between 2007 and today. They must be thinking of me as lazy or bizarre person that never attends any meetings or seminars. The plain reason has been money, I needed to work all-time instead of sitting and having conversations with friends. Other times I have had family reasons. I am sorry about the situation. I do believe though Mr. Charlie Chaplin s advice: Don t go to parties to show yourself. Instead make them come to your movies But I DO regret being this bad company. My sincere apology.
The Raising
The coming years will tell me, wether it is possible to recover from the drivers seat. However, I will make a try.
EOF
Blogtheristo

item.title: (LSJ) My first entry from IPhone
item.content:encoded:
Squarespace iPhone Application with Mobile ConsultingSquarespace Editor App in IPhone

The first edit session


I am finally writing this Lifetime Scope Journal entry with My iPhone. The Api for Squarespace Ipone App works quite easily and intuitively. Words seem to auto translate to Finnish, and I don t know how to change the dictionary in IPhone. Odd words pop-up and if I am not very cautious Finglish is put inside the text.

 

My opinion: Stars 4 / 5 Good: This App really works with IPhone, and feels immediately useful.


The second edit session

My first lesson was that the save button is really needed when writing with IPhone. Since editing is made off-line, all changes needs to be saved before trying to add pictures to the Story.I learned this after loosing to the data universe this second paragraph. (online/offline editing)

With two photos the upload is OK

My opinion: Stars 2 / 5 Not yet OK: The Screen flickers out with a slight mistouch when editing. I lose some text.


The Third edit session:The pictures

For Some reason the picture I took for this entry does not upload? I got frustrated about the picture uploader, and uploaded this picture with PC. The Picture is in IPhone client, but I cannot send it

Third edit session revisited

Today, the pictures seem to upload OK.

My opinion: Stars 3 / 5 quite OK: Again, for me, the upload is a bit mystery. There is no notification when pictures are uploaded.However, I lost the very beatiful picture that I took earlier, and uploaded this crappy screen image (lost picture).

The fourth edit session


For editing, the IPhone application is not at its best. But for toning ideas (few lines is all I am willing to type with the App) , and making notes it is perfect.


My opinion: Stars 3- / 5 OK: Summary: This application will Rock, and it already boosts my blogging productivity for sure. To edit anywhere helps brainstorming and creating ideas for Posts.

Checking comments is also great feature. Maybe I will go for 4- / 5 ..

The early bird version bugs will propably be fixed faster than I can think. Squarespace Pros should continue their efforts of creating their App as the finest Blog editing  tool available for mobile platform. Perhaps also I could edit other accounts too like Typepad, Blogger etc. with it?

Pictures feature do work with multiple photos

To get the latest news about Squarespace IPhone App see the Reference entry.

 

Questions and answers

Q: What is Squarespace IPhone App good for?

A: According the Squarespace site (Reference), the main features for the App is now

  • View my site statistics

This works well. Thank you !

  • Manage my content

This works well. Only limitation is Interface IPhone is providing. You may want to buy an IPhone Keyboard.

  • Previewing the site (in mobile)

This works well.

  • Editing posts

With limitations.

  • Managing multiple accounts

Not tested yet.

  • Managing Comments

Not tested yet.

  • Uploading multiple pictures / images (maybe videos later on)

Works OK.

  • Online/Offline editing

Again, well done, works OK.

  • Chillin Out

I need to take this App and girlfriend to a dinner to see how everything goes..

  • All the features coming in the update.

I will try to update this entry in Lifetime Scope Journal (LSJ) when I see new improvements for the functionality. Thank you!

 

Q: How I begin to use Squarespace editor in IPhone ?

A: Just go to Apple AppStore in Itunes, connect your IPhone, download the Squarespace app, enter your login information for any Squarespace account, and you are all set for your first Mobile blog entry and admin session.

Q: Do I still need a workstation for editing?

A: Yes, since most of the functionality for modifying the Post are not implemented. Offline editing is great for writing the idea of an entry. Taking pictures and video will make this tool even more useful.

Q: Any plans to use this tool?

A: It would be great to write on-spot story about Marathon Race Vantaa Marathon, Shoot the Running to a video plus zillion photos, upload the story to my workstation to finish.

item.title: (LSJ) Facebook mobile platform is choice for 200 million FB friends
item.content:encoded:
I am fan of Facebook Mobile Platform. The nicest feature for me has been the easy way to share photos from my whereabouts here in Espoo, and make a Photo Album from the places I visit when working with Mobile Office Service.

I enjoy reading and participating with my friends in Live Feed. Especially I have fun with my favourite blogs which sends updates to different pages I administer, and to my personal wall.

Sometimes Messages that I receive makes me update my daily calendar with a meeting or a seminar that I deside to attend ..and so on. Facebook Mobile App is awesome!

As Page administrator, it is important to see that everything is OK with the pages I manage. Also, answering wall posts is ideally done with Mobile platform. Facebook Mobile App is already a productions tool for Lifetime Studios crew.

In a LiveStream Show from Facebook Live Innovations yesterday, few new important features are coming out for the Facebook Mobile Platform. The 3 most important things about Facebook mobile Platform were:

1) Single-Sign On with Facebook Connect and sharing data between Applications

Mobile Apps are using one Single-Sign On feature so that I don’t need to log-in various services when I am on the road. Jumping in and out with Foursquare, Panoramio, Facebook, Iphone Pictures, etc. does not really enhance my mobile experience. For the next version of these and many other Mobile Apps, I can rely on Facebook Connect and use one login for all of the services I need. Further more, the Apps share data, so I can see in FB Places data of my friends whereabouts from f.e. Yelp or Foursquare.

2) Places information is shared between Social Platforms

The whereabouts of my friends and the Business Services I tend to like are important data for any business.

For the next version, the application I am using does not restrict me to seeing friends using some other application interface to see my updating location information. If you tag yourself with Foursquare, I can still see your place information in Facebook Mobile Apps, and so on. We find each other no matter which social platform we are using. As a developer, I get access to read and Write APIs in Facebook APIs (See more @TechCrunch). This enables applications like Google Places ChatRooms (Video)  - ChatSquare.

Developer Ecosystem follow unified Game Plan!

These enhanced and unified DataSets mean that Mobile Social / Local Apps are now easier to create and provide with meaningful data. According Facebook guys, this results to a wealth of Next Generation Social Mobile Apps.

At the LiveStream show a sneak peek for a next generation application were presented. The newest Application of using Places information for Business purposes is Application called Facebook Deals.

3) Deals Platform comes to The Coffee Shop near you !

Looking for a good Cup of Coffee somewhere near? Looking if someone of your friends are near and if there is any good Coffee Shops there? Or, you are walking in town some tuesday night, and want to go local Karaoke Bar, which is known for Rock Music Karaoke? To get your answer you can do the following with Facebook Deals App.

First, you login to Facebook Mobile with Facebook Connect, and check-in your Place to Places. You get a listing of your friends near-by. Secondly you a get a recommendation from your third friend about the Coffee Shop just two blocks away. When you click the Coffee Shop you see that with the Deals App, the Coffee Shop has created a Coupon deal of (50 % Off) for you. This convinces you to send a message to your friend to see her over a nice cup of coffee. You enter the Coffee Shop, just show this coupon (from the phone screen) at the shop, and you and your friend are ready for nice coffee hour.

item.title: (LSJ) Buzz is big in Social Media
item.content:encoded:
(LSJ, Editor in Chief)

 

This Entry:http://bit.ly/9sVqNn 

 

Blogtheristo Your comment is awaiting moderation. 
February 11th, 2010 at 6:37 am (#)

 

Day One comments (from Buzz): One day using Buzz I can only congratulate the maker team and you Jyri E ! Google Buzz is the best damn Google Product so far. It is highly addictive yet easy adapt for gmail fan.

 

I like the possibility to filter Buzzes to different threads or folders especially to save time and to keep order.

 

How big of a step Buzz is in the Social Media road map?

 

It somewhat replaces the need of installed twitter readers for many of us. We will see what is happening Tweetdeck, Seesmic now with Ping.fm, or Yoono’s connections to Buzz.

 

The impression is that is more personal than Facebook. The Discussions are more native and spontaneous than in Twitter.

 

The Syncronization with other Social Media services including my blogs seem to work OK.

 

Week One: The Privacy issues started to annoy. Someone found out my Blogger blogs and was able to send immediate updates to blogs via post method. The first fear caused were broken password, which made me close blogtheristo blogs. After cleaning that wednesday night all spam out of the blogs, and changed the passwords etc. I noticed that the company mail was full of notices of the emai not delivered. Due the fact that Blogger account had old email address the spam entries generated great amount of emails pinging in and out of different email accounts. It took me to the next morning to really find what this was all about. The Buzz was not treatin me nicely.

 

The Noise Issue: Too much people, so little time. So many threads, so little knowledge (from me that is).

 

Second Week: I restricted my writings mostly to private, deleting some of the first ones,  stopped following any aggrerators and power twitterers (not in the Buzz that is), took out links and data from my Buzz profile that did not belong there, and tried to participate to Buzz discussions.

 

The best part of Buzz is that so many friends can be found there to discuss and to learn. Thank for having me as your trusted fellow Buzzer.

 

The Role of Twitter

 

The role of Twitter seems to be as it were before Buzz. Or I respect it little more than before. Thank you Twitter folks !

 

The Role of Facebook

 

No change.

 

What has changed with Buzz?

 

The biggest change is towards how I now see relationship with Google. There is pros and cons to this(Tba).

 

Good

 

Discussions with friends and learning from new discussions. Easy to adapt and participate.

 

Bad

 

Robert Scoble has written excellent techical analysis about Buzz. He mentiones the main issues from the technical side.

 

Google as dirty sweetener of my contacts, data, and allowing spammers and criminals take advantage of my account by lowering my privacy - the main concern for many with Buzz friends. I hope fixes come as fast as the apology..

item.title: (LSJ) Personal invitation from Risto Päärni: Why Unyk Spam?
item.content:encoded:

item.title: (LSJ) Turning Customer Relations into Profitable Customer Accounts with CRM
item.content:encoded:
The Goal is to segment and maintain more Profitable Accounts

Developing and leading Customer Relations that turn into profitable Customer Accounts is the most important long-term goal for an Entrepreneur.

Managing in daily operations Customer Relations is done with various methods and tools. The most influencial are

  1. Phone Contacting
  2. Email Contacting
  3. Ads marketing
  4. Writing blog entries
  5. Commenting entries
  6. Tweeting
  7. Updating fan pages
  8. Updating Status Lines
  9. Web page Comments
  10. Adding and commenting Pictures
  11. Participating Discussions
  12. Chat Online
  13. Participating Seminars
  14. Pitch Contents
  15. Online Conferencing B-to-B
  16. Virtual Teams
  17. Writing fan page entries

 

The Role of Social Media in Customer Relations

Social Media in my opinion belongs to both methods and tools of my Customer Relations Management Arsenal. It is very useful of finding new prospects, partners, competitors, and success stories in any industry given.

The Objectives for Customer Relations Management

The Objectives for Customer Relations Management System

Improving the Sales with well segmented and targeted Marketing Process

  • Streamlined Sales process; better Return of Sales: Higher Close Rates.
  • Highly targeted, well segmented Marketing process

Analyzing Customer Base and finding cross-selling and up-selling opportunities.

Improved service level quality

Listening your customer feedback is always a good and propably the cheapest market Research effort. Priorization and Implementing Customer

Focus on Customer loyalty, and retention

The build of Customer Relations take years. The old saying, that keeping existing customers is always cheaper than finding new ones may be true. For finding new customers, web 2.0 based services and Social Media are tools that best serve your interests.

Segmenting the Customer Base

For a Entrepreneur, better profiling and targeting of current customers is vitally important to reduce expenses and raised overall profitability. Price Management, Increased market share are common objectives for Company Executives to address the need for a new Customer Relations Management Project Launch.

Do our customers have easy access to people that can answer their questions ?

Screening and the Evaluation of Project for CRM Automation

To successfully implement a CRM Automation / System in your company you can start by answering the following questions:


1. Is separate Customer Relations Management System (or SaaS) necessary for your business?

2. How beneficial is Customer Relations Management System for a company?  What are the main weaknesses we need to address?

3. What is the strategy and the best tools to combine CRM and Social Media?

4. How Company needs to develop its internal processes to meet the challenge of CRM system to fully benefit of the new way of operations management?

The Evaluation Project

The ignite of CRM project is best lead by experienced company Project Manager assisted with external consultant. The screening of different solutions is usually in the Gantt-Diagram / Task List of the Pre-Project Team.

 

Lifetime Studios, based in Espoo, Finland offers Social Media and ICT SaaS Consulting Services. Contact Us for any new Project Phase including new software evaluation, Project Management, Social Media Marketing, or Virtual Team building needs in the Scandinavia / EU / Global Region.

Publishing great entries of (LSJ) is combination of great writing, photos, code segments, and some inspiration (sometimes perspiration). Squarespace.com offers some nice Gallery options for publishing photos. But, when the photos are not yours, it is more realistic to create net folder in Picasa, and give full rights to the Photographer himself over his intellectual property. To be honest, this Picasa Gallery is not yet at the level of Professional  Art Gallery, but the good of this solution is that the folder can be shared with different level of rights to all parties involved (let’s think about presenting a group of new talents and their work). item.title: (LSJ) How is marketing practised?
item.content:encoded:
(LSJ)  I am currently reading a great compilation of Marketing Management by Kotler,  Kevin Lane Keller, Mairead Brady, Malcolm  Goodman, Torben Hansen . Here are some thoughts and notes from the marketing mix, and marketing management including relationship marketing.

Marketing Management, Marketing mix, Marketing Operations

The marketing practice can be viewed from many perspectives.

  • Kotlerian view: Managing the marketing mix after selecting target market(s) and positioning.
  • Marketing mix (McCarthy): 4P;product, price, place, promotion.
  • Marketing mix (Boden): 7P; product/service, price, promotion, place, people, process, physical evicence.

The 7Ps of the marketing mix represent the company’s view of the marketing tools available for influencing buyers.

Again, sell value, not price (Kotler). Marketing can be seen as identification, creation, communication, delivery and monitoring of customer value.

Satisfaction reflects a person’s judgement of a service’s or products perceived perfomance.

If it the customer feels satisfaction good, then value of your offering is high.
